a: La tayhane leh amaltera, deha hechol amaltera haveya leh, vaafillu hachi — esrim amma hu degavoah, ditnan: chamesh amalteraot shel mela hayu al gabbav, zo lemala mizzo, vezo lemala mizzo.
Vehay may teyuveta? dilma ki tanya hahi daamalteraot, baulam tanya?
Vehay may kusheya? dilma tavnit hechal ketavnit ulam?
Allema amar rabbi ila amar rav: rechava arbaa, af al pi sheenah beria. veim yesh lah amaltera afillu gevoha yoter meesrim amma eno tzarich lemaet.
Amar rav yosef: amaltera matnita hi, man katane la?
Amar abbaye: veha chama bereh derabba bar avu katane la, vetihve amaltera matnita vetikshe lerav!
Amar lecha rav: dal ana mehacha, matneyayta mi la kashyayn ahadade? ella may it lach lememar — tannae hi, ledidi name tannae hi.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: bela rav — matneyayta ahadade la kashyayn: lerabbanan kora tama may — mishshum hekkera, vehay dekatane "yater mippitcho shel hechol" — simana bealma.

Verav nachman bar yitzchak, hanicha i la sevira leh ha derabba, ella i sevira leh ha derabba, deamar rabba, ketiv: "lemaan yedu dorotechem ki vassukkot hoshavti", ad esrim amma adam yodea sheddar bassukka, lemala meesrim amma en adam yodea, mishshum dela shalta beh ena.
Alma gabbe sukka name behekkera peligi, ippeloge betarte lema li?

Tzericha, dei ashmeinan gabbe sukka — beha kaamar rabbi yehuda kevan delishiva avida, shalta beh ena. aval mavoy, dilhilluch avid — ema mode lehu lerabbanan. vei ashmeinan beha — beha kaamri rabbanan, aval behach ema modu leh lerabbi yehuda. tzericha.
May amaltera? rav chama bereh derabba bar avu amar: kinne. ki ata rav dimi amar, amri bemareva: piske dearza.
Man deamar piske dearza, kol shekken kinne. man deamar kinne, aval piske dearza la.
Uman deamar piske dearza may tama — mishshum dinfish meshacheh. veha sukka dinfish meshacheh, vekaamri rabbanan dela!
Ella: kevan deka chashiv it leh kala.
Miktzat kora betoch esrim, umiktzat kora lemala meesrim, miktzat sechach betoch esrim, umiktzat sechach lemala meesrim? amar rabba: bemavoy kasher, besukka pasul.
May shena bemavoy dechasher, deamrinan kelosh? sukka name lema kelosh!
I kalshat — havya la chamatah merubba mitztzillatah.
Hacha name, i kalshat havya la kora hannittelet baruach. ella al korchach, naasu keshappudin shel mattechet. hacha name — al korchach naaset tzillatah merubba mechammatah!
Amar rava mipparzakya: sukka dilyachid hi la middechar, mavoy dilrabbim madkeri ahadade.
Ravina amar: sukka deorayyta — achmiru ba rabbanan, mavoy derabbanan — la achmiru beh rabbanan.
Rav adda bar matna matne leha shemata derabba ippecha. amar rabba: bemavoy pasul, besukka keshera!
May shena sukka dichshera, deamrinan kelosh? bemavoy name lema kelosh!

I kelashat, have la kora hannittelet beruach. hacha name, i kalshat — havya la chamatah merubba mitztzillatah! ella al korchacha, naaset tzillatah merubba mechammatah, hacha name, al korchach naasu keshappudin shel mattechet!
Amar rava mipparzakya: sukka dilyachid hi rame annafsheh umiddechar, mavoy dilrabbim hi samchi ahadade vela middachri, deamri inashe: kidra deve shuttafe, la chammima vela karira.
Ravina amar: sukka deorayyta — la bae chizzuk. mavoy derabbanan — bae chizzuk.
May have ala? rabba bar rav ulla amar: ze vaze — pasul. rava amar: ze vaze kasher.
b: Chalal sukka tenan, chalal mavoy tenan.
Amar leh rav pappa lerava, tanya dimsayyay lach: mavoy shehu gavoah meesrim amma yoter mippitcho shel hechol yemaet. vehechol gufo chalalo esrim.
Etiveh rav shimi bar rav ashe lerav pappa: ketzad haya ose — manniach kora missefat esrim ulematta!
Ema: "ulemala". veha "lematta" katane!
Ha ka mashma lan, dilmatta kilmala: ma lemala chalalah esrim, af lematta chalalah asara.
Amar abbaye mishshemeh derav nachman: ammat sukka veammat mavoy beamma bat chamishsha, ammat kilayim beamma bat shishsha.
Ammat mavoy beamma bat chamishsha, lemay hilcheta? legovho ulefirtzat mavoy.
Veha ikka meshech mavoy bearba ammot, dilkulla!
Keman deamar bearbaa tefachim.
Veibbaet ema, bearba ammot — verov ammot kaamar.
Ammat sukka beamma bat chamishsha, lemay hilcheta? legovhah uledofen akumma.
Veha ikka meshech sukka bearba ammot, dilkulla! detanya, rabbi omer: omer ani, kol sukka sheen bah arba ammot al arba ammot pesula!
Kerabbanan, deamri: afillu enah machzeket ella rosho verubbo veshulechano.
Veibbaet ema: leolam rabbi hi, verov ammot kaamar.
Ammat kilayim beamma bat shishsha, lemay hilcheta? lekarachat hakkerem velimchol hakkerem.
Ditnan: karachat hakkerem, bet shammay omrim: esrim vearba ammot, uvet hillel omrim: shesh esre ammot. umechol hakkerem, bet shammay omrim: shesh esre ammot, uvet hillel omrim: shetem esre ammot.
Ezo hi karachat hakkerem? kerem shecharav emtzaito, en sham shesh esre ammot lo yavi zera lesham. hayu sham shesh esre amma — noten lo kede avodato, vezorea et hammotar.
Veezehu mechol hakkerem — ben kerem laggader. en sham shetem esre amma, lo yavi zera lesham. hayu sham shetem esre amma — noten lo kede avodato, vezorea et hashshear.
Veha ikka retzufim bearba ammot, dilkulla! ditnan: kerem hannatua al pachot mearba ammot, rabbi shimon omer: eno kerem. vachachamim omrim: kerem, veroin et haemtzaiyyim keillu enam.
Kerabbanan, deamri have kerem. veibbaet ema: leolam rabbi shimon, verov ammot kaamar.
Verava mishshemeh derav nachman amar: kol ammot beamma bat shishsha, ella: hallalu sochakot, vehallalu atzevot.
Metivi: kol ammot sheamru chachamim beamma bat shishsha, uvilvad

a: Shello yehu mechuuonot. bishlama lerava — ki hechi delihevyayn hallalu sochakot vehallalu atzevot. ella leabbaye kashya!
Amar lach abbaye, ema: ammat kilayim beamma bat shishsha.
Veha middekatane sefa: rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kol ammot sheamru chachamim bechilayim beamma bat shishsha, uvilvad shello yehu metzumetzamot, mikkelal detanna kamma kol ammot kaamar!
Amar lach abbaye: velav mi ikka rabban shimon ben gamliel dekae kevoti, ana daamari kerabban shimon ben gamliel.
Leabbaye vadday tannae hi. lerava mi lema tannae hi?
Amar lach rava: rabban shimon ben gamliel ha ata leashmoinan: ammat kilayim lo yetzamtzem.
Velema: "ammat kilayim lo yetzamtzem", beamma bat shishsha lemaote may? lav lemaote ammat sukka veammat mavoy?
La, lemaote amma yesod veamma sovev,

Dichtiv: "veelle middot hammizbeach baammot amma amma vatofach vechek haamma veamma rochav ugevulah el sefatah saviv zeret haechad veze gav hammizbeach". "chek haamma" — ze yesod, "veamma rochav" — ze sovev, "ugevulah el sefatah saviv" — ellu hakkeranot, "veze gav hammizbeach" — ze mizbach hazzahav.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: shiurin chatzitzin umechitzin, halacha lemoshe missinay.
Shiurin?! deorayyta hu! dichtiv: "eretz chitta useora vegomer", veamar rav chanan: kol happasuk hazze leshiurin neemar —

"Chitta", lichditnan: hannichnas labbayit hamenugga vechelav al ketefav, vesandalav vetabbeotav beyadav — hu vehem temein miyyad. haya lavush kelav, vesandalav beraglav, vetabbeotav beetzbeotav hu tame miyyad, vehen tehorin ad sheyyishhe bichde achilat peras — pat chittin velo pat seorin, mesev veochel beliftan.
"Seora", ditnan: etzem kisora metamme bemagga uvemassa, veeno metamme beohel.
"Gefen": kede reviit yayin lenazir.
b: "Teena": kigrogeret lehotzaat shabbat.
"Rimmon", keditnan: kol kele baale vattim shiuran kerimmonim.
"Eretz zet shemen (udevash)": eretz shekkol shiureha kezetim. kol shiureha salka datach?! vehaikka hane daamaran! ella ema: eretz sherov shiureha kezetim.
"Devash", kechotevet haggassa leyom hakkippurim.
Vetisbera shiurin michtav ketivi? ella hilcheta ninhu, veasmechinhu rabbanan akkerae.

Chatzitzin, deorayyta ninhu! dichtiv: "verachatz et kol besaro (bammayim)", shello yehe davar chotzetz ben besaro lammayim. "bammayim" — beme mikve. "kol besaro" — mayim shekkol gufo ole bahen, vechamma hen — amma al amma berum shalosh ammot. veshiaru chachamim me mikve arbaim sea.
Ki itzterich hilcheta, lisaro. vechidrabba bar rav huna, deamar rabba bar rav huna: nima achat keshura chotzetzet, shalosh enan chotztzot, shetayim eni yodea.
Searo name deorayyta hu, detanya: "verachatz et kol besaro" — et hattafel livsaro, vezehu sear!
Ki atay hilcheta lerubbo ulemiuto ulemakpid ulesheen makpid, vechidrabbi yitzchak.

Deamar rabbi yitzchak: devar tora rubbo umakpid alav chotzetz, vesheeno makpid alav eno chotzetz. vegazru al rubbo sheeno makpid mishshum rubbo hammakpid, veal miuto hammakpid mishshum rubbo hammakpid.
Veligzor name al miuto sheeno makpid mishshum miuto hammakpid, i name mishshum rubbo sheeno makpid!
Hi gufa gezera, vaanan nekum venigzor gezera ligzera?!
Mechitztzot, deorayyta ninhu!
Deamar mar: aron tisha vechapporet tefach, hare kan asara.
La tzericha, lerabbi yehuda deamar: ammat binyan beamma bat shishsha. ammat kelim beamma bat chamishsha.
Ulerabbi meir deamar: kol haammot hayu bevenonit, may ikka lememar?
Lerabbi meir, ki atay hilcheta — legud ulelavud uledofen akumma.
Haya gavoah meesrim amma uva lemaato, kamma memaet? kamma memaet?! kamma ditzrich leh!
Ella: rochbo bechamma? rav yosef amar: tefach, abbaye amar: arbaa.
Lema beha ka mippalgi deman deamar tefach, kasavar: muttar lehishtammesh tachat hakkora,

a: Uman deamar arbaa, kasavar: asur lehishtammesh tachat hakkora!
La, dechulle alma kasavri muttar lehishtammesh tachat hakkora, uveha ka mippalgi: mar savar kora mishshum hekker, umar savar kora mishshum mechitza.

Veibbaet ema, dechulle alma kora mishshum hekker, vehacha — behekker shel matta uvehekker shel mala ka mippalgi, demar savar amrinan hekker shel matta kehekker shel mala, umar savar la amrinan hekker shel matta kehekker shel mala.
Veibbaet ema: dechulle alma amrinan: hekker shel matta kehekker shel mala, vehacha bigzera shemma yifchot kamippalgi.
Haya pachot measara tefachim vechakak bo lehashelimo laasara, kamma chokek? kamma chokek?! kamma ditzrich leh! ella mishko bechamma? rav yosef amar: bearbaa, abbaye amar: bearba ammot.
Lema bidrabbi amme verabbi assi kamippalgi, deittemar: mavoy shennifratz mitztziddo kelappe rosho, ittemar mishshemeh derabbi amme verabbi assi: im yesh sham pas arbaa — mattir befirtza ad eser.
Veim lav, pachot mishshelosha mattir. shelosha eno mattir. lerav yosef it leh derabbi amme, leabbaye let leh derabbi amme.
Amar lach abbaye: hatam sof mavoy, hacha techillat mavoy. i ikka arba ammot — in, i la — la.
Amar abbaye: mena amena la — detanya: en mavoy nittar belechi vekora ad sheyyehu battim vachatzerot petuchin letocho.
Vei bearbaa hechi mashkachat leh!
Vechi tema defatach le bedofen haemtzai, vehaamar rav nachman: nekitinan, ezehu mavoy shennittar belechi vekora kol sheorko yater al rochbo, uvattim vachatzerot petuchin letocho.
Verav yosef: defatach le bekeren zavit.

Amar abbaye: mena amena la — deamar rame bar chama amar rav huna: lechi habbolet middofno shel mavoy, pachot mearba ammot — niddon mishshum lechi, veeno tzarich lechi acher lehattiro. arba ammot — niddon mishshum mavoy vetzarich lechi acher lehattiro.
Verav yosef? leappoke mittorat lechi ad deikka arba ammot. lemihve mavoy afillu bearbaa tefachim name have mavoy.
Gufa. amar rame bar chama amar rav huna: lechi habbolet middofno shel mavoy
b: Pachot mearba ammot — niddon mishshum lechi, veen tzarich lechi acher lehattiro. arba ammot — niddon mishshum mavoy, vetzarich lechi acher lehattiro.
Oto lechi, hechan maamido? i demoke leh bahadeh, osofe hu deka mosif aleh.
Amar rav pappa: demoke leh leiddach gisa. rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar: afillu tema demoke le bahadeh dimtappe beh, o dimvatztzar beh.
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: la amaran, ella bemavoy shemona. aval bemavoy shiva — nittar beomed merubbe al happarutz.
Vekal vachomer mechatzer: uma chatzer sheenah nitteret belechi vekora — nitteret beomed merubbe al happarutz, mavoy shennittar belechi vekora — eno din shennittar beomed merubbe al happarutz?
Ma lechatzer shekken pirtzatah beeser, tomar bemavoy sheppirtzato bearba!
Kasavar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: mavoy name, pirtzato beeser. leman kaamrinan? lerav huna, veha rav huna pirtzato bearba sevira leh?!
Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua tama denafsheh kaamar.
Rav ashe amar: afillu tema bemavoy shemone name la tzerich lechi, ma nafshach: i omed nefish nittar beomed merubbe al happarutz, vei parutz nefish niddon mishshum lechi.
May amrat, deshavu tarvayyhu ki hadade — have leh sefek divrehen, usefek divrehen lehakel.
Amar rav chanin bar rava amar rav: mavoy shennifratz

a: Mitztziddo — beeser, merosho — bearbaa.
May shena mitztziddo beeser — deamar pitcha hu, merosho name nema pitcha hu!
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: kegon shennifratz bekeren zavit, defitcha bekeren zavit la avdi inashe.
Verav huna amar: echad ze veechad ze bearbaa. vechen amar leh rav huna lerav chanan bar rava: la tiflog illay derav ikkela ledamcharya vaavad ovada kevoti. amar leh: rav bika matza vegadar bah gader.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: kevoteh derav huna mistabbera, deittemar: mavoy akom — rav amar: torato kimfullash. ushemuel amar: torato kesatum.
Bemay askinan? ilema beyoter meeser — beha lema shemuel torato kesatum?
Ella lav beeser, vekaamar rav torato kimfullash, alma pirtzat mavoy mitztziddo bearbaa!
Verav chanan bar rava, shane hatam deka baki ba rabbim.
Mikkelal derav huna savar af al gav dela baki ba rabbim, may shena midderabbi amme verabbi assi?
Hatam deikka giddude, hacha delekka giddude.

Tanu rabbanan: ketzad mearvin derech reshut harabbim? ose tzurat happetach mikkan, velechi vekora mikkan. chananya omer: bet shammay omrim: ose delet mikkan vedelet mikkan ucheshehu yotze venichnas noel. bet hillel omrim: ose delet mikkan, velechi vekora mikkan.
Ureshut harabbim mi miarva?! vehatanya: yater al ken amar rabbi yehuda,
b: Mi shehayu lo shene vattim mishshene tzidde reshut harabbim, ose lechi mikkan velechi mikkan, o kora mikkan vekora mikkan, venose venoten baemtza. amru lo: en mearvin reshut harabbim bechach.
Vechi tema bechach hu dela miarva, ha bidlatot miarva, vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: yerushalayim, ilmale daltoteha ninalot ballayla — chayyayvin aleha mishshum reshut harabbim!
Veamar ulla: hane avulle demachoza ilmale daltotehen ninalot — chayyayvin alehen mishshum reshut harabbim.
Amar rav yehuda, hachi kaamar: ketzad mearvin mevoot hamefullashin lirshut harabbim, ose tzurat happetach mikkan velechi vekora mikkan.
Ittemar. rav amar: hilcheta ketanna kamma. ushemuel amar: halacha kachananya.

Ibbaya lehu: lachananya allibba devet hillel tzarich linol, o en tzarich linol? ta shema, deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: eno tzarich linol. vechen amar rav matna amar shemuel: eno tzarich linol. ikka deamri amar rav matna: bedidi hava ovada, veamar li shemuel: en tzarich linol.
Beo minneh merav anan: tzarich linol o en tzarich linol? amar lehu: ta chazi hane avulle dinhardaa detiman ad palgayyhu beafra, veayel venafek mar shemuel, vela amar lehu vela midde.
Amar rav kahana: hanach megufot havay.
Ki ata rav nachman amar: panneyu leafrayyhu. lema kasavar rav nachman: tzarich linol? la, kevan diruyot linol, af al pi sheen ninalot.
Hahu mavoy akom dahava binhardea, reme aleh chumereh derav vechumereh dishmuel, veatzrechuhu delatot. chumereh derav — deamar: torato kimfullash. vehaamar rav halacha ketanna kamma?!
Kishmuel — deamar: halacha kachananya. vehaamar shemuel torato kesatum! kerav deamar torato kimfullash.

Umi avdinan kitre chumere? veha tanya: leolam halacha kevet hillel, veharotze laasot kedivre bet shammay ose, kedivre bet hillel ose. mikkulle bet shammay umikkulle bet hillel — rasha. mechumere bet shammay umechumere bet hillel — alav hakkatuv omer: "hakkesil bechoshech holech". ella, i kevet shammay kekullehon uchechumerehon, i kevet hillel kekullehon uchechumerehon.
Ha gufa kashya. amrat: leolam halacha kevet hillel, vahadar amrat: harotze laasot kedivre bet shammay ose?!
La kashya: kan — kodem bat kol. kan — leachar bat kol.
Veibbaet ema: ha veha — leachar bat kol,

a: Verabbi yehoshua hi dela mashgach bevat kol.

Veibbaet ema, hachi kaamar: kol hecha demashkachat tere tannae utere amorae difligi ahadade keen machaloket bet shammay uvet hillel — la lebad ki kulleh demar vechi kulleh demar, vela kechumereh demar vechi chumereh demar. ella, o ki kulleh demar uchechumereh aved, o kekulleh demar uchechumereh aved.
Mikkol makom kashya!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: kulleh kerav avdu. deamar rav huna amar rav: halacha veen morin ken.
Ulerav adda bar ahava amar rav, deamar: halacha umorin ken, may ikka lememar?
Amar rav shezvi: ki la avdinan kechumere deve tere — hecha desatri ahadade.

Kegon shidra vegulegolet. ditnan: hashshidra vehaggulegolet shechasru — vechamma chesron? bashshidra, bet shammay omrim: shete chuleyot, uvet hillel omrim: chuleya achat. uvaggulegolet, bet shammay omrim: kimlo makdeach, uvet hillel omrim: kede sheyyinnatel min hachay veyamut.
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: vechen leinyan terefa.
Aval hecha dela satri ahadade avdinan.
Vehecha desatri ahadade la avdinan?! metiv rav mesharsheya: maase berabbi akiva shellikket etrog beechad bishvat, venahag bo shene issurin: echad kedivre bet shammay, veechad kedivre bet hillel?!
Rabbi akiva gemareh istappek leh, vela yeda i bet hillel bechad bishvat amur, i bachamesar bishvat amur, vaavad hacha lechumera vehacha lechumera.
Yatev rav yosef kammeh derav huna, veyatev vekaamar, amar rav yehuda amar rav: machaloket bisratya mikkan useratya mikkan, ufelatya mikkan ufelatya mikkan.
Aval seratya mikkan uvika mikkan, o bika mikkan uvika mikkan — ose tzurat happetach mikkan velechi vekora mikkan.
Hasheta seratya mikkan uvika mikkan, ose lo tzurat happetach mikkan velechi vekora mikkan — bika mikkan uvika mikkan mibbaya?!
Hachi kaamar: seratya mikkan uvika mikkan — naase kevika mikkan uvika mikkan.
Umesayyem ba mishshemeh derav yehuda: im haya mavoy kale lirchava, en tzarich kelum.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: ha derav yehuda dishmuel hi.
b: Dei derav — kashya derav adderav betarte: deamar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav: mavoy shennifratz bimloo lechatzer, venifretza chatzer kenegdo — chatzer mutteret umavoy asur. veammay? leheve kemavoy shekkale lirchava!

Amar leh: ana la yadana, ovada hava bedura deraavata mavoy shekkale lirchava hava, vaata lekammeh derav yehuda vela atzrecheh vela midde. vei kashya mishshemeh derav — tehve mishshemeh dishmuel, vela kashya midde.
Hasheta daamar leh rav sheshet lerav shemuel bar abba, veamri leh lerav yosef bar abba: asbera lach, kan — sheervu, kan — shello ervu.
Derav adderav name la kashya: kan — sheervu bene chatzer im bene mavoy, kan — shello ervu.

a: Ulemay dislek addatin meikkara ben sheervu uven shello ervu peligi: beervu bemay peligi, beshello ervu bemay peligi?
Beshello ervu — peligi benire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim.
Beervu — kamippalgi bidrav yosef. deamar rav yosef: lo shanu ella shekkale leemtza rechava, aval kale letzidde rechava — asur.
Amar rabba: ha deamrat "leemtza rechava muttar", la amaran ella ze shello keneged ze, aval ze keneged ze — asur.

Amar rav mesharsheya: ha deamrat "ze shello keneged ze muttar", la amaran ella rechava derabbim, aval rechava deyachid, zimnin demimmelach ala uvene la battim, vehave la kemavoy shekkale le letzidde rechava veasur.

Umena temra deshane lan ben rechava derabbim lirchava deyachid — deamar ravin bar rav adda, amar rabbi yitzchak: maase bemavoy echad shetztziddo echad kale layyam vetziddo echad kale leashpa, uva maase lifne rabbi, velo amar bah lo hetter velo issur.
Issur la amar ba — deha kayymi mechitztzot. hetter la amar ba — chayyshinan shemma tinnatel ashpa, veyaale hayyam sirton.
Umi chayyshinan shemma tinnatel ashpa? vehatnan: ashpa birshut harabbim gavoah asara tefachim, challon sheal gabbah — zorkin lah beshabbat.
Alma shane ben ashpa derabbim leashpa deyachid.
Hacha name, shane ben rechava derabbim lirchava deyachid.
Verabbanan may?

Amar rav yosef bar avdimi, tana: vachachamim osrin; amar rav nachman: halacha kedivre chachamim. ikka deamri: amar rav yosef bar avdimi, tana: vachachamim mattirin; amar rav nachman: en halacha kedivre chachamim.
Marimar pasek la lesura beuzele. amar: chayyshinan shemma yaale hayyam sirton.

Hahu mavoy akom dahava besura, keruch budeya otivu beh beakmumiteh. amar rav chisda: ha la kerav vela kishmuel. lerav deamar torato kimfullash — tzurat happetach bae. lishmuel deamar torato kesatum — hane mille lechi mealleya. aval hay, kevan denashev beh zika veshade leh — lo kelum hu.
Vei naetz beh sikketa vechabbereh — chabbereh.
Gufa, amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav: mavoy shennifratz bimloo lechatzer, venifretza chatzer kenegdo — chatzer mutteret, umavoy asur.
Amar leh rabba bar ulla lerav bivi bar abbaye: rabbi, lo mishnatenu hi zo? "chatzer ketanna shennifretza ligdola — gedola mutteret uketanna asura, mippene shehi kefitchah shel gedola".
Amar leh: i mehatam hava amena: hane mille hecha dela ka darsi bah rabbim, aval hecha deka darsi ba rabbim — ema afillu chatzer name.
Veha name tenena: chatzer sheharabbim nichnasin lah bazo veyotzin lah bezo, reshut harabbim lattumea, ureshut hayyachid lashshabbat.
I mehatam hava amena: hane mille, ze shello keneged ze.
b: Aval ze keneged ze, ema la.
Ulerabba deamar ze keneged ze asur, ha derav bemay moke lah — beze shello keneged ze, tarte lema li?
I mehatam hava amena: hane mille lizrok, aval letaltel — ema la. ka mashma lan.
Ittemar: mavoy heasuy kenaddal, amar abbaye: ose tzurat happetach laggadol, vehanach kullehu mishteru belechi vekora.
Amar leh rava: keman, kishmuel deamar torato kesatum — lema leh tzurat happetach? veod, ha hahu mavoy akom dahava binhardea, vechashshu lah lidrav!
Ella amar rava: ose tzurat happetach lechullehu lehay gisa, veiddach gisa mishteru belechi vekora.

Amar rav kahana bar tachlifa mishshemeh derav kahana bar minyome mishshemeh derav kahana bar malkiyyo mishshemeh derav kahana rabbeh derav, veamri lah, rav kahana bar malkiyyo hayeynu rav kahana rabbeh derav: mavoy shetztziddo echad aroch vetziddo echad katzar, pachot mearba ammot manniach et hakkora baalachson. arba ammot — eno manniach et hakkora ella keneged hakkatzar. rava amar: echad ze veechad ze eno manniach et hakkora ella keneged hakkatzar.
Veema tama didi, veema tama didhu. ema tama didi: kora tama may — mishshum hekker, uvaalachson la have hekker.
Veema tama didhu, kora mishshum may — mishshum mechitza. uvaalachson name have mechitza.

Amar rav kahana: hoil ushemateta dechahane hi, ema ba milleta. ha deamrat manniach hakkora baalachson, la amaran ella sheen baalachsono yoter meeser, aval yesh baalachsono yoter meeser, divre hakkol eno manniach ella keneged hakkatzar.

Ibbaya lehu: mahu lehishtammesh tachat hakkora? rav verabbi chiyyay verabbi yochanan amru: muttar lehishtammesh tachat hakkora. shemuel verabbi shimon bar rabbi verabbi shimon ben lakish amru: asur lehishtammesh tachat hakkora.
Lema beha kamippalgi, demar savar: kora mishshum hekker, umar savar: kora mishshum mechitza.
La, dechulle alma kora mishshum hekker, vehacha beha kamippalgi, demar savar: hekkera millegav, umar savar: hekkera millevar.
Veibbaet ema: dechulle alma mishshum mechitza, vehacha beha kamippalgi, demar savar: chuddo happenimi yored vesotem, umar savar: chuddo hachitzon yored vesotem.
Amar rav chisda: hakkol modim beven lechayayim sheasur.
Bea minneh rame bar chama merav chisda: naatz shete yetedot bishne kotle mavoy mibbachutz, vehinniach kora al gabbehen, mahu?
Amar leh: ledivre hammattir — asur, ledivre haoser — muttar.
Rava amar: ledivre haoser name asur — bainan kora al gabbe mavoy, velekka.
Etiveh rav adda bar matna lerava: hayta korato

a: Meshucha o teluya, pachot mishshelosha — en tzarich lehavi kora acheret. shelosha — tzarich lehavi kora acheret. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: pachot mearbaa — en tzarich lehavi kora acheret, arbaa — tzarich lehavi kora acheret.
May lav — meshucha mibbachutz, uteluyah mibbifnim!
La, idi veidi mibbifnim. meshucha — meruach achat, uteluya — mishte ruchot.
Mahu detema: meruach achat amrinan lavud, mishte ruchot — la amrinan lavud, ka mashma lan.

Rav ashe amar: meshucha vehi teluya, vehechi dame? kegon shennaatz shete yetedot akummot al shene kotle mavoy, sheen begovhan shelosha, veen beakmumitan shelosha. mahu detema: o "lavud" amrinan, o "chavot" amrinan, lavud vachavot la amrinan. ka mashma lan.
Tane rabbi zakkay kammeh derabbi yochanan: ben lechayayim vetachat hakkora niddon kecharmelit. amar leh: pok teni levara.
Amar abbaye: mistabbera milleteh derabbi yochanan tachat hakkora, aval ben lechayayin asur. verava amar: ben lechayayim name muttar.
Amar rava: mena amena la — dechi ata rav dimi, amar rabbi yochanan: makom sheen bo arbaa al arbaa, muttar livne reshut harabbim velivne reshut hayyachid lechattef alav, uvilvad shello yachalifu.
Veabbaye, hatam begavoah shelosha.
Amar abbaye mena amena la — deamar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: toch happetach, tzarich lechi acher lehattiro.
Vechi tema: deit beh arbaa al arbaa, vehaamar rav chanin bar rava amar rav: toch happetach, af al pi sheen bo arbaa al arbaa tzarich lechi acher lehattiro.
Verava — hatam defatuach lecharmelit.
Aval lirshut harabbim may — shere? yatztziva beara vegiyyora bishme shemayya!
In, matza min et mino veneor.

Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerava: veat la tisbera deven lechayayin asur? vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: mavoy shertzafo bilchayayin pachot pachot mearbaa — banu lemachloket rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbanan.

Lerabban shimon ben gamliel deamar: amrinan lavud, mishtammesh ad chuddo happenimi shel lechi happenimi. lerabbanan, deamri: la amrinan lavud, mishtammesh ad chuddo happenimi shel chitzon. aval ben lechayayin dechulle alma asur!
Verava, hatam name defatuach lecharmelit.
Aval lirshut harabbim may — shere? yatztziva beara vegiyyora bishme shemayya! in, matza min et mino veneor.
b: Rav ashe amar: kegon shertzafo bilchayayim pachot pachot mearbaa bemeshech arba ammot.
Lerabban shimon ben gamliel deamar: amrinan lavud — have leh mavoy, vetzarich lechi acher lehattiro. ulerabbanan deamri: la amrinan lavud — lo tzarich lechi acher lehattiro.
Uleribben shimon ben gamliel, leheve kenire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim!
Midde hu tama ella lerabbi yochanan, ha ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: nire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim eno niddon mishshum lechi.

Ittemar: nire mibbifnim veshave mibbachutz — niddon mishshum lechi. nire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim, rabbi chiyyay verabbi shimon berabbi, chad amar: niddon mishshum lechi, vechad amar: eno niddon mishshum lechi.

Tistayyem derabbi chiyyay hu deamar "niddon mishshum lechi", detane rabbi chiyyay: kotel shetztziddo echad kanus mechavero, ben shennire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim, uven shennire mibbifnim veshave mibbachutz niddon mishshum lechi, tistayyem.
Verabbi yochanan mi la shemia leh ha?! ella shemia leh vela savar la, rabbi chiyyay name la savar la!
Hay may?! bishlama rabbi yochanan la savar la — mishshum hachi la tane la. ella rabbi chiyyay, i ita dela savar la, lema leh lemitna?

Amar rabba bar rav huna: nire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim — niddon mishshum lechi. amar rabba, umotvinan ashshematin: chatzer ketanna shennifretza ligdola — gedola mutteret uketanna asura, mippene shehi kefitchah shel gedola. veim ita, ketanna name tishtere benire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim.
Amar rabbi zera: benichnasin kotle ketanna ligdola.
Velema lavud vetishtere!
Vechi tema demaflegi tuva? veha tane rav adda bar avimi kammeh derabbi chanina: ketanna, beeser. gedola, beachat esre!
Amar ravina: bemufelagin mikkotel ze bishnayim, umikkotel ze bearbaa.
Velema lavud meruach achat, vetishtere.

a: Rabbi hi, deamar: bainan shene passin. detanya: chatzer, nitteret befas echad, rabbi omer: bishne passin.

Hay may? i amrat bishlama: nire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim — eno niddon mishshum lechi, verabbi savar la kerabbi yose, uderabbi zera uderavina leta — mishshum hachi ketanna beeser ugedola beachat esre, mishshum derabbi savar la kerabbi yose.
Ella i amrat: nire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim — niddon mishshum lechi, uderabbi zera uderavina ita, verabbi la savar la kerabbi yose — gedola beachat esre lema li?
Mimma nafshach: i lemishreyay ligdola kaate — beeser ushene tefachim saggi. vei lemesra liktanna kaate — leashmoinan demaflegi tuva.
Ella lav, shema minna: nire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim — eno niddon mishshum lechi. shema minna.
Amar rav yosef: la shemia li ha shemateta.

Amar leh abbaye: at amart nihalan, veaha amart nihalan — deamar rame bar abba amar rav huna: lechi hammoshech im dofno shel mavoy, pachot mearba ammot niddon mishshum lechi, umishtammesh im chuddo happenimi. arba ammot niddon mishshum mavoy, veasur lehishtammesh bechullo.
Veat amart lan ala: shema minna telat. shema minna: ben lechayayin asur. ushema minna: meshech mavoy bearba. ushema minna: nire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim niddon mishshum lechi.
Vehilcheta: nire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim — niddon mishshum lechi. teyuveta vehilcheta?
In, mishshum detane rabbi chiyyay kevoteh.
Veharachav meeser yemaet. amar abbaye, tana: veharachav meeser yemaet, rabbi yehuda omer: eno tzarich lemaet. vead kamma?
Savar rav achay kammeh derav yosef lememar: ad shelosh esre amma ushelish. vekal vachomer mippasse viraot.

Uma passe viraot shehittarta bahen parutz merubbe al haomed — lo hittarta bahen yoter mishshelosh esre amma ushelish, mavoy shello hittarta bo parutz merubbe al haomed, eno din shello tattir bo yoter mishshelosh esre amma ushelish?

Vehi hannotenet: passe viraot shehittarta bahen parutz merubbe al haomed — lo tattir bahen yoter mishshelosh esre amma ushelish, mavoy shello hittarta bo parutz merubbe al haomed — tattir bo yoter mishshelosh esre ammot ushelish!
I name leiddach gisa: passe viraot deakkelt behu chad kulla — akkel behu kulla acharina, mavoy kelal kelal la.
Tane levi: mavoy shehu rachav esrim amma, noatz kane beemtzaito, vedayyo. hu tane la vehu amar la: deen halacha keotah mishna. ikka deamri, amar shemuel mishshemeh delevi: en halacha keotah mishna.
Ella hechi aved? amar shemuel mishshemeh delevi:
b: Ose pas gavoah asara bemeshech arba ammot, umaamido leorko shel mavoy.
I name kidrav yehuda, deamar rav yehuda: mavoy shehu rachav chamesh esre amma — marchik shete ammot veose pas shalosh ammot.
Veammay? yaase pas amma umechetza, veyarchik shete ammot, veyaase pas amma umechetza. shema minna: omed merubbe al happarutz mishte ruchot la have omed!
Leolam ema lach have omed, veshane hacha, deate avvera dehay gisa veavvera dehay gisa umevattel leh.
Veyaase pas amma veyarchik amma, veyaase pas amma veyarchik amma, veyaase pas amma. shema minna omed kefarutz — asur!
Leolam ema lach — muttar, veshane hacha deate avvera dehay gisa udehay gisa umevattel leh.
Veyarchik amma veyaase pas amma umechetza, veyarchik amma veyaase pas amma umechetza.
In hachi name, vechulle hay la atrechu rabbanan.
Velechush dilma shavek pitcha rabba, veayel befitcha zuta! amar rav adda bar matna: chazaka en adam manniach petach gadol venichnas befetach katan.
Umay shena midderabbi amme uderabbe assi?
Hatam ka memaet behillucha. hacha la ka memaet behillucha.
Tenan hatam: or haasla vechalal shello — mitztarfin betefach.
May "or haasla"? amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: or kissuy shel bet hakkisse.
Vechamma? ki ata rav dimi, amar: etzbaayim mikkan, veetzbaayim mikkan, veetzbaayim revach baemtza. ki ata ravin, amar: etzba umechetza mikkan, veetzba umechetza mikkan, veetzba revach baemtza.
Amar leh abbaye lerav dimi: mi peligitu? amar leh: la, ha — beravrevata, ha — bezuterata, vela peligin.
Amar leh: laye, peligitu, uveomed merubbe al happarutz mishte ruchot peligitu. ledidach have omed mishte ruchot, leravin meruach achat — have omed, mishte ruchot — la have omed.
Dei salka datach la peligitu, leravin hachi ibbei leh lememar: etzba ushelish mikkan, veetzba ushelish mikkan, veetzba ushelish revach baemtza.
Veella may — peliginan? ledidi, hachi ibbei li lememar: etzba ushene shelishim mikkan, veetzba ushene shelishim mikkan, veetzbaayim ushene shelishim revach baemtza.
Ella i ikka lememar difliginan — bifarutz keomed peliginan.
Im yesh lo tzurat happetach, af al pi sherachav meeser — eno tzarich lemaet. ashkechan tzurat happetach demahneya berachbo, vaamaltera demahneya begovho.

a: Ippecha may?
Ta shema detanya: mavoy shehu gavoah meesrim amma yemaet, veim yesh lo tzurat happetach eno tzarich lemaet.
Amaltera berochbo may? ta shema, detanya: mavoy shehu gavoah meesrim amma yemaet, veharachav meeser yemaet, veim yesh lo tzurat happetach eno tzarich lemaet, veim yesh lo amaltera eno tzarich lemaet.
May lav assefa: la, aresha.
Matne leh rav yehuda lechiyyay bar rav kammeh derav: eno tzarich lemaet. amar leh: atneyeh, tzarich lemaet.
Amar rav yosef: middivre rabbenu nilmad: chatzer sherubbah petachim vechallonot — enah nitteret betzurat happetach.

May tama — hoil veyoter meeser oser bemavoy, ufarutz merubbe al haomed oser bechatzer. ma yoter meeser haoser bemavoy — eno nittar betzurat happetach, af parutz merubbe al haomed haoser bechatzer — eno nittar betzurat happetach.
Ma leyoter meeser haoser bemavoy — shekken lo hittarta bo etzel passe viraot lerabbi meir, tomar befarutz merubbe al haomed haoser bechatzer — shekken hittarta etzel passe viraot ledivre hakkol.
Lema mesayyay leh: defanot hallalu sherubban petachim vechallonot muttar, uvilvad sheyyehe omed merubbe al happarutz.
Sherubban salka datach? — ella ema: sheribba bahen petachim vechallonot, uvilvad sheyyehe omed merubbe al happarutz.
Amar rav kahana: ki tanya hahi — befitche shimae.
May pitche shimae? peligi ba rav rechumi verav yosef. chad amar: delet lehu shikfe, vechad amar: delet lehu tikra.

Veaf rabbi yochanan savar la leha derav. deamar ravin bar rav adda amar rabbi yitzchak: maase beadam echad mibbikat bet chortan shennaatz arbaa kunedesin bearba pinnot hassade, umatach zemora alehem. uva maase lifne chachamim, vehittiru lo leinyan kilayim.
Veamar resh lakish: kederech shehittiru lo leinyan kilayim kach hittiru lo leinyan shabbat. rabbi yochanan amar: lechilayim hittiru lo, leinyan shabbat lo hittiru lo.
Bemay askinan? ilema min hatztzad, vehaamar rav chisda: tzurat happetach sheasaah min hatztzad lo asa velo chelum.
Ella al gabban. uvemay? ilema beeser — beha lema rabbi yochanan beshabbat la?!
Ella lav — beyater meeser.
La, leolam beeser umin hatztzad — uvidrav chisda ka mippalgi.
Uremi derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan, uremi deresh lakish adderesh lakish, deamar resh lakish mishshum rabbi yehuda berabbi chanina:
b: Pea mutteret leinyan kilayim, aval lo leshabbat. verabbi yochanan amar: kimchitztzot leshabbat dela, kach mechitztzot lechilayim delo.
Bishlama deresh lakish adderesh lakish la kashya: ha — dideh, ha — derabbeh. ella derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan kashya!
I amrat bishlama: hatam — al gabban, hacha — min hatztzad, shappir. ella i amrat: idde veidde min hatztzad, may ikka lememar?
Leolam, idde veidde min hatztzad: hatam — beeser, hacha — beyoter meeser.

Umena temra deshane lan ben eser leyoter meeser — daamar leh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: lo kach haya hammaase, shehalach rabbi yehoshua etzel rabbi yochanan ben nuri lilmod tora, af al pi shebbaki behilchot kilayim, umetzao sheyyoshev ben hailanot umatach zemora meilan leilan. veamar lo: rabbi, i gefanim kan mahu lizroa kan? amar lo: beeser muttar, beyoter meeser asur.
Bemay askinan? ilema al gabban yoter meeser asur — vehatanya: hayu sham kanin haddokranin veasa lahen pea milmala, afillu beyoter meeser muttar!
Ella lav min hatztzad, vekaamar leh beeser muttar, yoter meeser asur. shema minna.
Gufa, amar rav chisda: tzurat happetach sheasaah min hatztzad — lo asa velo chelum.
Veamar rav chisda: tzurat happetach sheamru, tzericha shettehe beria kede lehaamid bah delet, vaafillu delet shel kashshin.
Amar resh lakish mishshum rabbi yannay: tzurat happetach tzericha hekker tzir. may hekker tzir? amar rav avya: avkata.
Ashkechinhu rav acha bereh derav avya letalmide derav ashe, amar lehu: amar mar midde betzurat happetach? amaru leh: lo amar velo kelum.
Tana: tzurat happetach sheamru, kane mikkan vekane mikkan vekane al gabbehen. tzerichin ligga, o en tzerichin ligga? rav nachman amar: en tzerichin ligga. verav sheshet amar: tzerichin ligga.

Azal rav nachman vaavad ovada be resh galuta kishmateh. amar leh rav sheshet leshammaeh rav gadda: zil, shelof shedinhu. azal, shelaf, shedinhu. ashkechuhu deve resh galuta, chavshuhu. azal rav sheshet, kam abbava, amar leh: gadda, pok ta! nefak vaata.

Ashkecheh rav sheshet lerabba bar shemuel, amar leh: tane mar midde betzurat happetach? amar leh: in, tenena: kippa, rabbi meir mechayyev bimzuza, vachachamim potrin. veshavin sheim yesh beragleha asara shehi chayyevet.
Amar abbaye: hakkol modim im gevoha asara veen beragleha shelosha, i name: yesh beragleha shelosha, veen gevoha asara — velo kelum.
Ki peligi beyesh beragleha shelosha ugevoha asara, veen rechava arbaa, veyesh bah lachok lehashelimah learbaa.
Rabbi meir savar: chokkin lehashelim, verabbanan savri: en chokkin lehashelim.
Amar leh: i mashkachat lehu — la tema lehu leve resh galuta vela midde meha matnita dechippa.
Mishna hechsher mavoy, bet shammay omrim: lechi vekora, uvet hillel omrim: o lechi o kora. rabbi eliezer omer: lechayayin.

Mishshum rabbi yishmael amar talmid echad lifne rabbi akiva: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al mavoy shehu pachot mearba ammot, shehu nittar o belechi o bekora. al ma nechleku — al rachav mearba ammot vead eser, shebbet shammay omrim: lechi vekora, uvet hillel omrim: o lechi o kora. amar rabbi akiva: al ze veal ze nechleku.
Gemara keman? dela kachananya vela ketanna kamma.
Amar rav yehuda, hachi kaamar: hechsher mavoy satum ketzad? bet shammay omrim: lechi vekora, uvet hillel omrim: o lechi o kora.
Bet shammay omrim: lechi vekora, lememra deka savri bet shammay: arba mechitztzot deorayyta.
La, lizrok — mishshalosh hu demichayyayv, letaltel — ad deikka arba.
Bet hillel omrim o lechi o kora. lema ka savri bet hillel shalosh mechitztzot deorayyta?
La, lizrok — mishshetayim hu demichayyayv, letaltel — ad deikka shalosh.
Rabbi eliezer omer lechayayin. ibbaya lehu: rabbi eliezer lechayayin vekora kaamar, o dilma lechayayin belo kora kaamar?
Ta shema: maase berabbi eliezer shehalach etzel rabbi yose ben perida talmido

a: Leovalin umetzao sheyyoshev bemavoy sheen lo ella lechi echad. amar lo: beni, ase lechi acher. amar lo: vechi lesotmo ani tzarich? amar lo yissatem, uma bechach.

Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al mavoy shehu pachot mearba ammot sheeno tzarich kelum, al ma nechleku, al rachav mearba ammot vead eser. shebbet shammay omrim: lechi vekora, uvet hillel omrim: o lechi o kora.
Katane mihat "vechi lesotmo ani tzarich", i amrat bishlama lechayayin vekora — mishshum hachi amar "vechi lesotmo ani tzarich". ella i amrat lechayayin belo kora — may lesotmo?
Hachi kaamar: vechi lesotmo bilchayayin ani tzarich?

Amar mar: amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al mavoy sheppachot mearba ammot sheeno tzarich kelum. veha anan tenan: mishshum rabbi yishmael amar talmid echad lifne rabbi akiva: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al mavoy shehu pachot mearba ammot shehu nittar o belechi o bekora!
Amar rav ashe, hachi kaamar: eno tzarich lechi vekora kevet shammay, velo lechayayin kerabbi eliezer, ella: o lechi o kora, kevet hillel.
Vechamma? amar rav achlay: veittema rav yechiel: ad arbaa.
Amar rav sheshet amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav: modim chachamim lerabbi eliezer befasse chatzer. verav nachman amar: halacha kerabbi eliezer befasse chatzer.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: man modim? — rabbi. halacha mikkelal difligi, [man pelig aleh] — rabbanan. detanya: chatzer nitteret befas echad. rabbi omer: bishne fassin.

Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: chatzer tzericha shene fassin. amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi assi: mi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? veha at hu deamrat mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: passe chatzer tzerichin sheyyehe bahen arbaa. vechi tema: arbaa mikkan vearbaa mikkan —
Vehatane rav adda bar avimi kammeh derabbi chanina, veamri la kammeh derabbi chanina bar pappi: ketanna beeser, ugedola beachat esre!
Ki salek rabbi zera miyyamme parsha: baruach achat bearbaa, mishte ruchot — mashshehu lechan umashshehu lechan.
Vehadtane adda bar avimi — rabbi hi, vesavar la kerabbi yose.

Amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: chatzer nitteret befas echad. amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: mi amar shemuel hachi? veha amar leh shemuel lerav chananya bar shela: at la taaved ovada ella o berov dofen o bishne fassin!
Amar leh: vaana la yadana, deovada hava bedura diruta, leshon yam hannichnas lechatzer hava. vaata lekammeh derav yehuda, vela atzrecheh ella pas echad.
Amar leh: leshon yam kaamrat, kal hu shehekellu chachamim bemayim.
Kediva minneh rabbi tavla merav: mechitza teluya, mahu shettattir bechureba? amar leh: en mechitza teluya matteret ella bemayim, kal hu shehekellu chachamim bemayim.
Mikkol makom kashya.
Ki ato rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua mibbe rav pershuha: meruach achat — bearbaa, mishte ruchot — mashshehu lechan umashshehu lechan.
Amar rav pappa: i kashya li — ha kashya li, daamar leh shemuel lerav chananya bar shela: at la taaved ovada ella o berov dofen o bishne fassin.

Lema li rov dofen? befas arbaa saggi! vechi tema may berov dofen bedofen shiva, divarbea hava leh rov dofen, lema li arbaa? bishlosha umashshehu saggi! deha amar rav achlay veittema rav yechiel: ad arbaa!
Ibbaet ema: kan — bechatzer, kan — bemavoy, veibbaet ema: derav achlay gufeh tannae hi.

Tanu rabbanan: leshon yam hannichnas lechatzer — en memallein hemennu beshabbat ella im ken yesh lo mechitza gavoah asara tefachim. bamme devarim amurim — sheppirtzato beyoter measara, aval asara — en tzarich kelum.
Mimla hu dela memalleinan, ha taltole metaltelinan. veha nifretza chatzer bimloah lemakom haasur lah!
b: Hacha vemay askinan — deit leh giddude.
Amar rav yehuda: mavoy shello nishtattefu bo, hichshiro belechi, hazzorek letocho — chayyayv, hichshiro bekora — hazzorek letocho patur.
Matkef la rav sheshet: tama delo nishtattefu bo, ha nishtattefu bo afillu hichshiro bekora name chayyayv?! vechi kikkar zo osa oto reshut hayyachid o reshut harabbim?
Vehatanya: chatzerot shel rabbim umevoot sheenan mefullashin, ben ervu uven lo ervu hazzorek letochan chayyayv!
Ella i ittemar, hachi ittemar: amar rav yehuda: mavoy sheeno rauy leshittuf, hichshiro belechi — hazzorek letocho chayyayv, hichshiro bekora — hazzorek letocho patur.
Alma kasavar: lechi mishshum mechitza vekora mishshum hekker. vechen amar rabba: lechi mishshum mechitza vekora mishshum hekker. verava amar: echad ze veechad ze mishshum hekker.
Etiveh rabbi yaakov bar abba lerava: hazzorek lemavoy, yesh lo lechi — chayyayv, en lo lechi — patur!
Hachi kaamar: eno tzarich ella lechi, hazzorek letocho — chayyayv, lechi vedavar acher — hazzorek letocho patur.
Etiveh, yater al ken amar rabbi yehuda: mi sheyyesh lo shene vattim bishne tzidde reshut harabbim, ose lechi mikkan velechi mikkan, o kora mikkan vekora mikkan, venose venoten baemtza.
Amru lo: en mearvin reshut harabbim bechach!
Hatam kasavar rabbi yehuda: shete mechitztzot deorayyta.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: mavoy sheorko kerochbo eno nittar belechi mashshehu. amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: mavoy sheorko kerochbo eno nittar bekora tefach.
Amar rabbi zera: kamma mechavvevnan shemata desave. kevan deorko kerochbo — have leh chatzer, vechatzer enah nitteret belechi vekora, ella befas arbaa.
Amar rabbi zera: i kashya li, ha kashya li: leheve hay lechi kefas mashshehu, venishtere!
Ishtemitteh ha deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: passe chatzer tzerichin sheyyehe bahen arbaa.

Amar rav nachman: naktinan, ezehu mavoy shennittar belechi vekora — kol sheorko yater al rochbo uvattim vachatzerot petuchim letocho, veezo hi chatzer sheenah nitteret belechi vekora ella befas arbaa — kol shemmerubbaat.
Merubbaat in, agulla la?! hachi kaamar: i orkah yater al rochbah — have leh mavoy, umavoy belechi vekora saggi, vei la — have la chatzer.
Vechamma? savar shemuel lememar: ad deikka pi shenayim berochbah. amar leh rav, hachi amar chavivi: afillu mashshehu.
Mishshum rabbi yishmael amar talmid echad kulei.

a: Rabbi akiva omer: al ze veal ze nechleku kulei.
Rabbi akiva hayeynu tanna kamma! ikka benayyhu derav achlay, veittema rav yechiel. vela mesayyeymi.
Tanya, amar rabbi akiva: la amar rabbi yishmael davar ze, ella oto talmid amar davar ze, vahalacha keoto talmid.
Ha gufa kashya: amrat "la amar rabbi yishmael davar ze" — alma let hilcheta kevoteh, vahadar amrat: "halacha keoto talmid"!
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo amarah rabbi akiva ella lechadded bah hattalmidim.
Verav nachman bar yitzchak amar: nirin ittemar.
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol makom sheatta motze "mishshum rabbi yishmael amar talmid echad lifne rabbi akiva" — eno ella rabbi meir, sheshshimmesh et rabbi yishmael veet rabbi akiva.
Detanya, amar rabbi meir: keshehayiti etzel rabbi yishmael hayiti metil kankantom letoch haddeyo, velo amar li davar. keshebbati etzel rabbi akiva, asarah alay.

Ini?! vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel mishshum rabbi meir: keshehayiti lomed etzel rabbi akiva hayiti metil kankantom letoch haddeyo, velo amar li davar. ucheshebbati etzel rabbi yishmael, amar li: beni, ma melachtecha? amarti lo: lavlar ani. amar li: beni, heve zahir bimlachtecha, shemmelachtecha melechet shamayim hi, shemma atta mechasser ot achat o meyayter ot achat — nimtzeta machariv et kol haolam kullo.
Amarti lo: davar echad yesh li vekankantom shemo, sheani metil letoch haddeyo. amar li: vechi metilin kankantom letoch haddeyo? vahalo amra tora: "vechatav umacha", ketav sheyyachol limmachot.
May kaamar leh, umay ka mehaddar leh?

Hachi kaamar leh: la mibbaya bachaserot uviterot [dela taena] — devaki ana, ella afillu mechash lizvuv name, dilma ate veyatev attageh dedalet umachek leh umeshavve leh resh — davar echad yesh li vekankantom shemo sheani metil letoch haddeyo.
Kashya shimmush ashshimmush, kashya asarah aasarah.

Bishlama shimmush ashshimmush la kashya: meikkara ata lekammeh derabbi akiva, umiddela matze lemekam allibbeh — ata lekammeh derabbi yishmael, ugemar gemara, vahadar ata lekammeh derabbi akiva, usevar sevara.
Ella asarah aasarah kashya! kashya.
Tanya rabbi yehuda omer, rabbi meir haya omer: lakkol metilin kankantom letoch haddeyo, chutz mipparashat sota. verabbi yaakov omer mishshemo: chutz mipparashat sota shebbammikdash.
May benayyhu? amar rav yirmeya: limchok lah min hattora ikka benayyhu.
Vehane tannae chi hane tannae, detanya: en megillatah keshera lehashekot bah sota acheret. rabbi achay bar yoshiyya amar: megillatah keshera lehashekot bah sota acheret.
Amar rav pappa: dilma la hi. ad kan la kaamar tanna kamma hatam — ella kevan deinnetik leshum rachel tu la hadra minnatka leshum lea, aval gabbe tora distama mikkatva, hachi name demachakinan.

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, dilma la hi: ad kan la kaamar rabbi achay bar yoshiyya hatam — ella deikketiv mihat leshum sota baolam, aval gabbe tora, dilhitlammed ketiva — hachi name dela mechakyanan.
Velet leh lerabbi achay bar yoshiyya ha ditnan: katav [get] legaresh et ishto,
b: Venimlach umetzao ben iro veamar: shimcha kishmi veshem ishtecha keshem ishti — pasul legaresh bo!
Hachi hasheta? hatam "vechatav lah" ketiv — bainan ketiva lishmah, hacha "veasa lah" ketiv — bainan asiyyay lishmah, asiyyay dida mechika hi.

Amar rabbi acha bar chanina: galuy veyadua lifne mi sheamar vehaya haolam sheen bedoro shel rabbi meir kemoto, umippene ma lo kavu halacha kemoto? shello yachlu chaverav laamod al sof dato. shehu omer al tame tahor umare lo panim, al tahor tame umare lo panim.

Tana: lo rabbi meir shemo ella rabbi nehoray shemo, velamma nikra shemo rabbi meir? shehu meir ene chachamim bahalacha. velo nehoray shemo ella rabbi nechemya shemo, veamri la rabbi elazar ben arach shemo, velamma nikra shemo nehoray? shemmanhir ene chachamim bahalacha.
Amar rabbi: hay dimchaddadna mechavray dachaziteh lerabbi meir meachoreh, veillu chaziteh mikkammeh hava mechaddadna tefe — dichtiv: "vehayu enecha root et morecha".

Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: talmid haya lo lerabbi meir vesomchos shemo, shehaya omer al kol davar vedavar shel tumea arbaim ushemone taame tumea, veal kol davar vedavar shel tohora arbaim ushemone taame tohora.
Tana: talmid vatik haya beyavne shehaya metaher et hashsheretz bemea vachamishshim teamim.
Amar ravina, ani adun vaataharennu: uma nachash shemmemit umarbe tumea — tahor, sheretz sheen memit umarbe tumea — lo kol shekken!
Vela hi — maase kotz bealma kaaved.

Amar rabbi abba amar shemuel: shalosh shanim nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel, hallalu omrim: halacha kemotenu, vehallalu omrim: halacha kemotenu. yatza bat kol veamra: ellu vaellu divre elohim chayyim hen, vahalacha kevet hillel.

Vechi meachar sheellu vaellu divre elohim chayyim, mippene ma zachu bet hillel likboa halacha kemotan? mippene shennochin vaaluvin hayu, veshonin divrehen vedivre bet shammay, velo od ella shemmakdimin divre bet shammay ledivrehen.

Keotah sheshshaninu: mi shehaya rosho verubbo bassukka veshulchano betoch habbayit, bet shammay poslin uvet hillel machshirin. amru bet hillel levet shammay: lo kach haya maase, shehalchu zikne bet shammay vezikne bet hillel levakker et rabbi yochanan ben hachoranit umetzauhu yoshev rosho verubbo bassukka veshulchano betoch habbayit. amru lahen bet shammay: i mishsham reaya?! af hen amru lo: im kach hayita noheg, lo kiyyaymta mitzvat sukka miyyamecha.

Lelammedcha shekkol hammashpil atzmo — hakkadosh baruch hu magbiho, vechol hammagbiah atzmo — hakkadosh baruch hu mashpilo. kol hamechazzer al haggedulla — gedulla borachat mimmennu, vechol habboreach min haggedulla — gedulla mechazzeret acharav, vechol haddochek et hashshaa — shaa dochakto, vechol hannidche mippene shaa — shaa omedet lo.

Tanu rabbanan: shete shanim umechetza nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel. hallalu omrim: noach lo leadam shello nivra yoter mishshennivra, vehallalu omrim: noach lo leadam shennivra yoter mishshello nivra. nimnu vegamru: noach lo leadam shello nivra yoter mishshennivra, achshav shennivra — yefashpesh bemaasav. veamri la: yemashmesh bemaasav.
Mishna hakkora sheamru rechava kede lekabbel ariach. veariach, chatzi levena shel shelosha tefachim. dayyay lakkora shettehe rechava tefach kede lekabbel ariach lerochbo.
Rechava kede lekabbel ariach uveria kede lekabbel ariach. rabbi yehuda omer: rechava af al pi sheen beria. hayta shel kash veshel kanim — roin otah keillu hi shel mattechet.
Akumma — roin otah keillu hi peshuta, agulla — roin otah keillu hi merubbaat. kol sheyyesh behekkefo shelosha tefachim yesh bo rochav tefach.

a: Gemara tefach, tefach umechetza bae!
Kevan derachav lekabbel tefach, iddach chatzi tefach melabben leh betina mashshehu mehay gisa umashshehu mehay gisa, vekayyma.

Amar rabba bar rav huna: kora sheamru — tzericha shettehe beria kede lekabbel ariach, umaamide kora — enan tzerichin sheyyihyu beriin kede lekabbel kora veariach. verav chisda amar: echad ze veechad ze tzerichin sheyyihyu beriin kede lekabbel kora veariach.

Amar rav sheshet: hinniach kora al gabbe mavoy, ufaras aleha machtzelet vehigbiah min hakkarka shelosha — kora en kan mechitza en kan. kora en kan — deha mikkasseya. mechitza en kan — dehavya la mechitza shehaggedayim bokin bah.

Tanu rabbanan: kora hayyotza mikkotel ze veenah nogaat bechotel ze, vechen shete korot achat yotza mikkotel ze veachat yotza mikkotel ze veenan nogot zo bazo, pachot mishshelosha — en tzarich lehavi kora acheret. shelosha — tzarich lehavi kora acheret.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: pachot mearba — en tzarich lehavi kora acheret, arba — tzarich lehavi kora acheret.

Vechen shete korot hammatimot, lo bezo kede lekabbel ariach velo bazo kede lekabbel ariach, im mekabbelot ariach lerochbo tefach — en tzarich lehavi kora acheret, veim lav — tzarich lehavi kora acheret.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: im mekabbelet ariach leorko shelosha — en tzarich lehavi kora acheret, veim lav — tzarich lehavi kora acheret.

Hayu achat lemala veachat lematta, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: roin et haelyona keillu hi lematta, veet hattachtona keillu hi lemala, uvilvad shello tehe elyona lemala meesrim amma vetachtona lematta measara.
Amar abbaye: rabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar la kaavu bachada, ufelig aleh bachada. savar la kaavu bachada — deit leh roin.
Ufelig aleh bachada — deillu rabbi yehuda savar: lemala meesrim, verabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar: betoch esrim in, lemala meesrim la.
Rabbi yehuda omer: rechava af al pi sheenah beria. matne leh rav yehuda lechiyyay bar rav kammeh derav: rechava af al pi sheenah beria. amar leh: atneyeh, rechava uveria.
Vehaamar rabbi ilay amar rav: rechava arbaa, af al pi sheenah beria! rechava arbaa shane.
Hayta shel kash kulei. may ka mashma lan, deamrinan roin — hayeynu hach!
Mahu detema: beminah amrinan, shello beminah — la amrinan. ka mashma lan.

Akumma roin otah keillu hi peshuta. peshita! ka mashma lan kidrabbi zera. deamar rabbi zera: hi betoch hammavoy veakmumitah chutz lammavoy, hi betoch esrim veakmumitah lemala meesrim, hi lemala measara veakmumitah lematta measara, roin kol sheillu yinnatel akmumitah veen ben ze laze shelosha — en tzarich lehavi kora acheret, veim lav — tzarich lehavi kora acheret.
Ha name peshita! hi betoch mavoy veakmumitah chutz lammavoy itztericha leh. mahu detema: lechush dilma ate leimmeshoche batra. ka mashma lan.
Agulla roin otah keillu hi merubbaat. ha tu lema li? sefa itztericha leh: kol sheyyesh behekkefo shelosha tefachim yesh bo rochav tefach.
Mena hane mille? amar rabbi yochanan, amar kera: "vayyaas et hayyam mutzak eser baamma missefato ad sefato agol saviv vechamesh baamma komato vekav sheloshim baamma yasov oto saviv".
Veha ikka sefato?!
Amar rav pappa: sefato sefat perach shoshan ketiv beh, dichtiv: "veovyo tefach usefato kemaase kos perach shoshan alpayim bat yachil".
Vehaikka mashshehu! ki ka chashev — miggavvay ka chashev.
Tanya rabbi chiyyay: yam sheasa shelomo haya machazik mea vachamishshim mikve tohora. mikkedi, mikve kamma have — arbaim sea, kidtanya: "verachatz et besaro
b: Bemayim" — beme mikve. "kol besaro" — mayim shekkol gufo ole bahen, vechamma hen? amma al amma berum shalosh ammot. veshiaru chachamim, me mikve arbaim sea.
Kamma havu lehu? chamesh mea garmide, litlat mea — mea, lemea vechamshin — chamshin. bearba mea vechamshin saggi!
Hane mille beribbua — yam sheasa shelomo agol haya.
Mikkede, kamma merubba yater al heagol? revia. learba mea — mea, lemea — esrim vachamishsha. hane mea veesrim vachamishsha havu lehu!
Tane rame bar yechezkel: yam sheasa shelomo, shalosh ammot tachtonot merubbaot, ushetayim elyonot agullot.
Nehi deippecha la matzet amrat — disfato agol" ketiv, ella ema chada!
La salka datach, dichtiv: "alpayim bat yachil". "bat" kamma havya — shalosh sein, dichtiv: "masar habbat min hakkor", dehave lehu shitta alfe gerive.
Veha ketiv: "machazik battim sheloshet alafim"? hahu legudesha.

Amar abbaye, shema minna: hay gudesha, tilta have. utenan name: shidda teva umigdal, kavvevret hakkash vechavvevret hakkanim, uvor sefina alekkesanderit, af al pi sheyyesh lahen shulayim vehen machazikot arbaim sea ballach, shehen korayim bayyavesh — tehorin.
Mishna lechayayin sheamru — govhan asara tefachim, verochban veovyayn kol shehu. rabbi yose omer: rochban shelosha tefachim.
Gemara lechayayin sheamru kulei. lema tenan setama kerabbi eliezer, deamar lechayayin bainan?
La, may lechayayin — lechayayin dealma. i hachi, kora name — nitne korot, umay korot: korot dealma!
Hachi kaamar: otan lechayayin shennechleku bahen rabbi eliezer vachachamim — govhan asara tefachim, verochban veovyayn kol shehu. vechamma kol shehu, tane rabbi chiyyay: afillu kechut hassarbal.
Tana asa lechi lachatzi mavoy en lo ella chatzi mavoy. peshita! ella ema: yesh lo chatzi mavoy. ha name peshita! mahu detema: lechush dilma ate leishtammoshe bechulleh, ka mashma lan.

Amar rava: asa lechi lemavoy vehigbiho min hakkarka shelosha, o shehifligo min hakkotel shelosha — lo asa velo chelum. afillu lerabban shimon ben gamliel deamar amrinan lavud — hane mille lemala, aval lematta, kevan dehavya mechitza shehaggedayin bokin bah — la kaamar.
Rabbi yose omer rochban shelosha tefachim. amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: en halacha kerabbi yose lo behelme velo bilchayayin.

Amar leh rav huna bar chinnana: behelme amart lan, bilchayayin la amart lan? may shena behelme — difligi rabbanan aleh, lechayayin name — peligi rabbanan aleh. amar leh: shane lechayayin, mishshum dekae rabbi kevoteh.

Rav rechumi matne hachi: amar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel [bar shilat] mishshemeh derav: en halacha kerabbi yose lo behelme velo bilchayayin. amar leh: amart? amar lehu: la. amar rava: haelohim! amra, ugemirna la minneh. umay tama ka hadar beh? mishshum derabbi yose nimmuko immo.
Amar leh rava bar rav chanan leabbaye: hilcheta may? amar leh: pok chazi may amma davar.

Ikka dematne la aha: hashshote mayim litzmao, omer: "shehakkol nihya bidvaro". rabbi tarfon omer: "bore nefashot rabbot vechesronan al kol ma shebbarata". amar leh rav chanan leabbaye: hilcheta may? amar leh: pok chazi may amma davar.

a: Ittemar: lechi haomed meelav, abbaye amar: have lechi, rava amar: la have lechi.

Hecha dela samchinan aleh meetmol, kulle alma la peligi dela have lechi. ki peligi hecha desamchinan aleh meetmol. abbaye amar: have lechi, deha samchinan aleh meetmol. rava amar: la have lechi, kevan demeikkara lav addateh dehachi avidi, la have lechi.
Ka salka datach ki hechi difligi belechi peligi name bimchitza.

Ta shema: haose sukkato ben hailanot veilanot defanot lah — keshera. hacha bemay askinan, shennetaan mittechilla lechach. i hachi peshita! mahu detema: ligzor dilma ate leishtammoshe beilan, ka mashma lan.
Ta shema: haya sham ilan o gader o chitzat hakkanim — niddon mishshum deyomad!
Hacha name, bemay askinan — sheasaan mittechilla lechach. i hachi may ka mashma lan? [ka mashma lan], chitzat hakkanim kane kane pachot mishshelosha tefachim, kediva minneh abbaye merabba.
Ta shema: ilan hammesech al haaretz, im en nofo gavoah min haaretz shelosha tefachim — metaltelin tachtav. hacha name, bemay askinan — shennetao mittechilla lechach.
I hachi, litaltel bechullo! allema amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: en metaltelin bo ella bet satayim.
Mishshum dehave dira shettashmishah laavir, vechol dira shettashmishah laavir, en metaltelin bah ella bet satayim.

Ta shema: shavat betel shehu gavoah asara vehu mearba ammot vead bet satayim, vechen beneka shehu amok asara, vehu mearba ammot vead bet satayim, vekama ketzura veshibbolot makkifot otah — mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma.
Vechi tema hacha name sheasa mittechilla lechach, bishlama kama lechayye, ella tel vaneka — may ikka lememar?

Ella: bimchitzot kulle alma la peligi dehavya mechitza, ki peligi — belechi. abbaye letameh deamar: lechi mishshum mechitza, umechitztza haasuya meeleha havya mechitza. verava letameh deamar: lechi mishshum hekker, i avida beyadayim havya hekker, vei la la have hekker.
Ta shema: avne gader hayyotzot min haggader muvedalot zo mizzo pachot mishshelosha, en tzarich lechi acher. shelosha — tzarich lechi acher.
Hacha name shebbenaan mittechilla lechach. i hachi, peshita! mahu detema lemesar binyayna hu daavida. ka mashma lan.
Ta shema, detane rabbi chiyyay: kotel shetztziddo echad kanus mechavero, ben shennire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim, uven shennire mibbifnim veshave mibbachutz — niddon mishshum lechi.
Hacha name sheasao mittechilla lechach. i hachi, may ka mashma lan? ha ka mashma lan: nire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim — niddon mishshum lechi.

Ta shema: derav hava yatev behahu mevoa, hava yatev rav huna kammeh. amar leh leshammaeh: zil ayyti li kuza demayya. ad daata, nefal lechya. achvi leh bideh kam adducheteh. amar leh rav huna: la savar la mar lismoch addikla? amar: dame hay merabbanan keman dela parshi inashe shemata, mi samchinan aleh meetmol?
Tama — dela samchinan, ha samchinan — have lechi.
Lema abbaye verava bidla samchinan aleh peligi, ha samchinan aleh — have lechi. la salka datach, dehahu barka dahava be bar chavu dahavo peligi ba abbaye verava kulle shenayyhu.
Mishna bakkol osin lechayayin afillu bedavar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim, verabbi meir oser. umetamme mishshum golel,
b: Verabbi meir metaher. vechotvin alav gitte nashim, verabbi yose haggelili posel.

Gemara tanya, rabbi meir omer: kol davar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim en osin oto lo dofen lesukka velo lechi lemavoy, lo passin leveraot velo golel lekever. mishshum rabbi yose haggelili amru: af en kotvin alav gitte nashim.

May tama derabbi yose haggelili, detanya: "sefer", en li ella sefer. minnayin lerabbot kol davar? talmud lomar "vechatav lah", mikkol makom. im ken ma talmud lomar "sefer"? lomar lach: ma sefer davar sheen bo ruach chayyim veeno ochel, af kol davar sheen bo ruach chayyim veeno ochel.
Verabbanan? mi ketiv "besefer"? "sefer" ketiv, lisfirut devarim bealma hu daata.

Verabbanan, hay "vechatav lah" may darshi beh? hahu mibbee leh: bichtiva mitgareshet, veenah mitgareshet bechesef. salka datach amena: hoil veittakkash yetzia lahavaya — ma havaya bechesef, af yetzia bechesef. ka mashma lan.
Verabbi yose haggelili, hay sevara mena leh? nafka leh missefer keritut": sefer kortah, veen davar acher kortah.

Verabbanan, hay "sefer keritut" mibbee leh ledavar hakkoret beno levenah. lechidtanya: hare ze gittech al menat shello tishti yayin, al menat shello telchi levet avich leolam — en ze keritut. kol sheloshim yom — hare ze keritut.
Verabbi yose haggelili, nafka leh mikkaret" "keritut".
Verabbanan "karet" "keritut" la darshi.
Mishna sheyayra shechanta bevika vehikkifuha kele vehema — metaltelin betochah. uvilvad sheyyehe gader gavoah asara tefachim, velo yehu pirtzot yeterot al habbinyan.
Kol pirtza shehi keeser ammot mutteret, mippene shehi kefetach. yater mikkan — asur.
Gemara ittemar, parutz keomed — rav pappa amar: muttar, rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar: asur.
Rav pappa amar muttar: hachi agmereh rachamana lemoshe — la tifrotz rubba. rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar asur: hachi agmereh rachamana lemoshe — gedor rubba.
Tenan: velo yehu pirtzot yeterot al habbinyan. ha kabbinyan — muttar?!
La tema ha kabbinyan muttar, ella ema: im binyan yater al happirtza — muttar.
Aval kabbinyan, may — asur? i hachi litne "lo yehu pirtzot kabbinyan"! kashya.
Ta shema: hamekare sukkato beshappudin o baarukkot hammitta, im yesh revach benehen kemotan — keshera!
Hacha bemay askinan: keshennichnas veyotze.
Veha efshar letzamtzem?
Amar rabbi amme: bemaadif.
Rava amar: im hayu netunin erev — notno sheti, sheti — notno erev.
Ta shema: sheyayra shechanta bevika vehikkifuha bigmallin, beukkafot,

a: Baavitin, bishlifin, bekanim, bekolachot — metaltelin betochah, uvilvad shello yehe ben gamal legamal kimlo gamal, uven ukkaf leukkaf kimlo ukkaf, uven avit leavit kimlo avit!
Hacha name keshennichnas veyotze.
Ta shema: nimtzeta atta omer, shalosh middot bimchitzot: kol shehu pachot mishshelosha, tzarich shello yehe ben ze laze shelosha, kede shello yizdakker haggedi bevat rosh.
Kol shehu shelosha, umishshelosha ad arbaa, tzarich shello yehe ben ze laze kimloo, kede shello yehe parutz keomed. veim haya parutz merubbe al haomed — af keneged haomed asur.

Kol shehu arbaa, umearbaa ad eser ammot, tzarich shello yehe ben ze laze kimloo, shello yehe parutz keomed. veim haya parutz keomed, keneged haomed — muttar, keneged happarutz — asur. veim haya omed merubbe al happarutz — af keneged happarutz muttar.
Nifretza beyoter meeser — asur, hayu sham kanim haddokranim veose lahen pea milmala, afillu beyoter meeser muttar.
Katane mihat resha mishshelosha ad arbaa, uvilvad shello yehe ben ze laze kimloo, teyuveta derav pappa!
Amar lecha rav pappa: may meloo — nichnas veyotze.
Hachi name mistabbera middekatane: im haya parutz merubbe al haomed — af keneged haomed asur. ha keomed — muttar. shema minna.
Lema tehve teyuveteh derav huna bereh derav yehoshua? amar lach: velitamaych, ema sefa: im haya omed merubbe al happarutz, af keneged happarutz muttar. ha kapparutz — asur!
Sefa kashya lerav pappa, resha kashya lerav huna bereh derav yehoshua.
Sefa lerav pappa la kashya: ayyeyde ditna resha "parutz merubbe al haomed", tena sefa "omed merubbe al happarutz".
Resha lerav huna bereh derav yehoshua la kashya: ayyeyde devae lemitne sefa "omed merubbe al happarutz", tena resha "parutz merubbe al haomed".
Bishlama lerav pappa, mishshum hachi la arev lehu vetane lehu.
Ella lerav huna bereh derav yehoshua — liarvinhu velitninhu: kol shehu pachot mishshelosha, ushelosha — tzarich shello yehe ben ze laze shelosha!
Mishshum dela dame pesula deresha lifsula desefa. pesula deresha — kede shello yizdakker haggedi bevat achat, pissula desefa — shello yehe parutz kaomed.
Pachot mishshelosha manni — rabbanan hi, deamri: pachot mishshelosha amrinan lavud, shelosha la amrinan lavud.
Ema sefa: kol shehu shelosha, umishshelosha vead arbaa —
b: Atan lerabban shimon ben gamliel deamar: pachot mearbaa lavud. dei rabbanan: mishshelosha vead arbaa? shelosha vearbaa chad hu.
Amar abbaye: midderesha rabbanan, sefa name rabbanan, umodu rabbanan dechol lemishre kenegdo, i ikka makom arbaa — chashiv, vei la — la chashiv.

Rava amar: middesefa rabban shimon ben gamliel, resha name rabban shimon ben gamliel. vechi amar rabban shimon ben gamliel amrinan lavud — hane mille lemala, aval lematta, have leh kimchitza shehaggedayim bokin bah — la amrinan: lavud.
Ta shema: defanot hallalu sherubban petachim vechallonot muttar, uvilvad sheyyehe omed merubbe al happarutz.
"Sherubban", salka datach?! ella: sheribba bahen petachim vechallonot muttar, uvilvad sheyyehe omed merubbe al happarutz.
Ha kapparutz asur, teyuveta derav pappa teyuveta. vehilcheta kevoteh derav pappa.
Teyuveta vehilcheta?! in, mishshum dedayyka matnitin kevoteh. ditnan: lo yihyu peratzot yeterot al habbinyan. ha kabbinyan muttar.
Mishna makkifin shelosha chavalim ze lemala mizze, vaze lemala mizze, uvilvad shello yehu ben chevel lachavero shelosha tefachim.
Shiur chavalim veovyayn yater al tefach, kede sheyyehe hakkol asara tefachim.
Makkifin bekanim, uvilvad shello yehe ben kane lachavero shelosha tefachim.
Bishyayra dibberu, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim: lo dibberu bishyayra, ella bahove.
Kol mechitza sheenah shel sheti veshel erev — enah mechitza, divre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim: echad mishshene devarim.
Gemara amar rav hamenuna amar rav: hare amru, omed merubbe al happarutz bishti — have omed. bae rav hamenuna: beerev may?
Amar abbaye, ta shema: shiur chavalim veovyayn yater al tefach, sheyyehu hakkol asara tefachim. vei ita — lema li yater al tefach?
Lebed pachot mishshelosha vechevel mashshehu, pachot mishshelosha vechevel mashshehu, pachot mearbaa vechevel mashshehu.
Vetisbera? hay pachot mearbaa hecha mokem leh? i mokem leh tattay, have leh kimchitza shehaggedayim bokin bah.
I mokem leh illay, ate avvera dehay gisa udehay gisa umevattel leh.
I mokem leh bemitze, have leh omed merubbe al happarutz mishte ruchot. shamat minna omed merubbe al happarutz mishte ruchot have omed!
Ella rav hamenuna hachi ka mibbaya leh: kegon deayyti machtzelet dehave shiva umashshehu, vachakak ba shelosha, ushevak ba arbaa umashshehu, veokmeh befachot mishshelosha.

Rav ashe amar: mechitza teluya ibbaya leh. kediva minneh rabbi tavla merav: mechitza teluya mahu shettattir bechureba? amar leh: en mechitza teluya matteret ella bammayim, kal hu shehekellu chachamim bemayim.
Makkifin bekanim vechulei. bishyara in, beyachid la? vehatanya, rabbi yehuda omer: kol mechitztzot shabbat lo hittiru leyachid yoter mibbet satayim.
Kidamar rav nachman veittema rav bivi bar abbaye: la nitzrecha ella litten lahen kol tzarkan, hacha name litten lahen kol tzarkan.
Hecha ittemar derav nachman veittema rav bivi bar abbaye? aha ditnan: kol mechitza sheenah shel sheti vaerev enah mechitza, divre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda.

Umi amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hachi? vehatanya: echad yachid veechad sheyayra lachavalim. uma ben yachid lishyayra? yachid notnin lo bet satayim, shenayim notnin lahem bet satayim, shelosha naasu sheyayra venotnin lahen bet shesh. divre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda.
Vachachamim omrim: echad yachid veechad sheyayra notnin lahen kol tzarkan, uvilvad shello yehe bet satayim panuy!
Amar rav nachman veittema rav bivi bar abbaye: la nitzrecha, ella litten lahen kol tzarkan.
Darash rav nachman mishshum rabbenu shemuel: yachid — notnin lo bet satayim, shenayim — notnin lehu bet satayim, shelosha — naasu sheyayra venotnin lahen bet shesh.
Shavakt rabbanan veavdat kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda?

Hadar okem rav nachman amora aleh uderash: devarim sheamarti lifnechem taut hen beyadi. beram kach amru: yachid — notnin lo bet satayim, shenayim — notnin lahen bet satayim, shelosha — naasu sheyayra venotnin lahen kol tzarkan.

a: Resha rabbi yose berabbi yehuda vesefa rabbanan?!
In, mishshum dekae avu beshitteh.
Amar rav giddel amar rav: shelosha bechamesh — asurin, besheva muttarin. amaru leh: amar rav hachi? amar lehu: orayyta nevie uchetive daamar rav hachi!
Amar rav ashe: may kashya? dilma hachi kaamar: hutzerchu leshesh vehikkifu besheva — afillu besheva muttarin. lo hutzerchu ella lechamesh vehikkifu besheva — afillu bechamesh asurin.
Veella ha dekatane: "uvilvad shello yehe bet satayim panuy" — may lav, panuy meadam? la, panuy mikkelim.
Ittemar: shelosha umet echad mehen, shenayim venittosfu alehen — rav huna verabbi yitzchak, chad amar: shabbat goremet, vechad amar: dayorin gormin.

Tistayyem derav huna hu deamar shabbat goremet. deamar rabba: beay merav huna, uveay merav yehuda: erav derech happetach venistam happetach, derech hachallon venistam hachallon, mahu? veamar li: shabbat hoil vehutera — huttera. tistayyem.

Lema rav huna verabbi yitzchak biflugeta derabbi yose verabbi yehuda kamippalgi? ditnan: chatzer shennifretza mishte ruchoteha, vechen bayit shennifratz mishte ruchotav, vechen mavoy shennittelu korotav o lechayav — muttarin leotah shabbat vaasurin leatid lavo, divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi yose omer: im muttarin leotah shabbat — muttarin leatid lavo, veim asurin leatid lavo — asurin leotah shabbat.
Lema rav huna deamar kerabbi yehuda verabbi yitzchak deamar kerabbi yose?
Amar lecha rav huna: ana daamari afillu lerabbi yose, ad kan la kaamar rabbi yose hatam — ella deletanhu limchitzot, hacha — itanhu limchitzot.
Verabbi yitzchak amar: ana daamari afillu lerabbi yehuda, ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda hatam — ella deitanhu ledayorin, hacha — letanhu ledayorin.
Vachachamim omrim echad mishshene devarim. hayeynu tanna kamma?
Ikka benayyhu yachid bayyishshuv.
Mishna arbaa devarim patru bammachane: meviin etzim mikkol makom, ufeturin merchitzat yadayim, umiddemay, umillearev.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: machane hayyotzet lemilchemet harshut muttarin begezel etzim yeveshim. rabbi yehuda ben tema omer: af chonin bechol makom. uvimkom shennehergu sham nikbarin.
Muttarin begezel etzim yeveshim. hay takkanta dihoshua hava? deamar mar, asara tenaim hitna yehoshua: sheyyehu marin bachorashin, umelakketin etzim missedotehen!
Hatam — behizme vehige, hacha — bishar etzim.
I name: hatam — bimchubbarin, hacha — bitlushin.
I name: hatam — belachin, hacha — biveshim.
Rabbi yehuda ben tema omer: af chonin bechol makom, uvimkom shenneheragim sham nikbarim. peshita, met mitzva hu, umet mitzva kone mekomo!
La tzericha, af al gav
b: Deit leh kovrin, detanya: ezehu met mitzva? kol sheen lo kovrin. kore vaacherim onin oto — en ze met mitzva.
Umet mitzva kana mekomo? vehatanya: hammotze met mutal bisratya — mefannehu limin isratya o lismol isratya.
Sede vur usede nir — mefannehu lisde vur. sede nir usede zera — mefannehu lisde nir. hayu shetehen nirot, shetehen zeruot, shetehen burot — mefannehu lechol ruach sheyyirtze!
Amar rav bivi: hacha bemet muttal al hammetzar askinan. mittoch shennittena reshut lefannoto min hammetzar — mefannehu lechol ruach sheyyirtze.
Ufeturin merchitzat yadayim. amar abbaye: lo shanu ella mayim rishonim, aval mayim acharonim chova.
Amar rav chiyyay bar ashe: mippene ma amru mayim acharonim chova? mippene shemmelach sedomit yesh, shemmesamme et haenayim.
Amar abbaye: umishtachcha kekureta bechora. amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: kayel milcha, may? amar leh: [ha] la mibbaya.

Umiddemay. ditnan: maachilin et haaniyyim demay veet achsanya demay. amar rav huna: tana, bet shammay omrim: en maachilin et haaniyyim demay veet achsanya demay, uvet hillel omrim: maachilin et haaniyyim demay veet achsanya demay.
Umillearev. amri deve rabbi yannay: lo shanu ella eruve chatzerot, aval eruve techumin chayyayvin.
Detane rabbi chiyyay: lokin al eruve techumin devar tora.
Matkef la rabbi yonatan: vechi lokin al lav shebbeal"? matkef rav acha bar yaakov: ella meatta dichtiv: "al tifnu el haovot veel hayyiddeonim", hachi name dela lake?!
Rabbi yonatan hachi kashya leh: lav shennittan leazharat mitat bet din. vechol lav shennittan leazharat mitat bet din — en lokin alav.
Amar rav ashe: mi ketiv "al yotzi"? "al yetze" ketiv.
Hadaran alach mavoy
Mishna osin passin leveraot.
Arbaa deyomdin nirin kishmona, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer: shemona nirin kishnem asar — arbaa deyomdim vearbaa peshutin.
Govhan asara tefachim, verochban shishsha veovyaym kol shehu. uvenehen kimlo shete revakot shel shalosh shalosh bakar, divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi yehuda omer: shel arba, keshurot velo muttarot, achat nichneset veachat yotzet.
Muttar lehakeriv labbeer, uvilvad shettehe para roshah verubbah bifnim veshota.
Muttar

a: Leharechik kol shehu, uvilvad sheyyarbe befassin. rabbi yehuda omer: ad bet satayim.

Amru lo: lo amru bet satayim ella leginna ulekarpef, aval im haya dir o sahar o muketze o chatzer — afillu bet chameshet korin, afillu bet asara korin muttar. umuttar leharechik kol shehu, uvilvad sheyyarbe befassin.
Gemara lema matnitin dela kachananya, detanya: osin passin levor vachavalin lishyayra. vachananya omer: chavalin levor, aval lo passin.
Afillu tema chananya bor lechud beer lechud.
Ikka deamri: middela katane "chananya omer: osin chavalin levor ufassin liver", mikkelal delachananya la shena bor vela shena beer — chavalin in, passin la. lema matnitin dela kachananya?
Afillu tema chananya, lemay dekaamar tanna kamma — ka mahdar leh.
Lema matnitin dela kerabbi akiva? ditnan: echad beer harabbim uvor harabbim uveer hayyachid osin lahen passin. aval bor hayyachid — osin lo mechitza gavoah asara tefachim, divre rabbi akiva.
Veillu hacha katane: leveraot. leveraot — in, levorot la.
Afillu tema rabbi akiva, beer mayim chayyim difsika leh, la shena derabbim vela shena deyachid — katane. bor mechunnasin dela pesika leh — la katane.
Lema matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda ben bava, ditnan: rabbi yehuda ben bava omer: en osin passin ella liver harabbim bilvad, veillu hacha katane leveraot — la shena derabbim vela shena deyachid!
Afillu tema rabbi yehuda ben bava, may beraot — beraot dealma.
May deyomdin? amar rabbi yirmeya ben elazar: deyo ammudin.
Deyo limnudde shevach zonit nitkalkel bemidda shelosha siman.
Tenan hatam, rabbi yehuda omer: kol hashshitin peturin, chutz min haddeyofra. may deyofra? amar ulla: ilan haose deyo perot bashshana.

Amar rabbi yirmeya ben elazar: deyo partzuf panim haya lo leadam harishon, shenneemar: "achor vakedem tzartani". ketiv: "vayyiven Adonai elohim et hatztzela vegomer", rav ushemuel: chad amar partzuf, vechad amar zanav.
Bishlama leman deamar partzuf — hayeynu dichtiv "achor vakedem tzartani". ella leman deamar zanav — may "achor vakedem tzartani"?
Kidrabbi amme, deamar rabbi amme: achor lemaase vereshit, vakedem lefureanut.

Bishlama achor lemaase vereshit — dela ibberi ad maale shabbeta, ella vakedem lefureanut may hi? illema mishshum kelala — ha battechilla nitkallel nachash, ulevassof nitkallela chavva, ulevassof nitkallel adam!
Ella lammabbul, dichtiv: "vayyimach et kol hayekum asher al pene haadama meadam vead behema vegomer".
Bishlama leman deamar partzuf, hayeynu dichtiv "vayyitzer" teren yodin. ella leman deamar zanav — may "vayyitzer"?
Kidrabbi shimon ben pazzi, deamar rabbi shimon ben pazzi: oy li miyyitzri, oy li miyyotzri.
Bishlama leman deamar partzuf, hayeynu dichtiv "zachar unekeva beraam". ella leman deamar zanav — may "zachar unekeva beraam"?
Lechidrabbi avahu. derabbi avahu rame, ketiv: "zachar unekeva beraam", uchetiv: "(ki) betzelem elohim bara oto". battechilla alta bemachshava livroot shenayim, ulevassof lo nivra ella echad.
Bishlama leman deamar partzuf, hayeynu dichtiv: "vayyisgor basar tachtenna", ella leman deamar zanav — may "vayyisgor basar tachtenna"?
Amar rav zevid, veittema rabbi yirmeya, veittema rav nachman bar yitzchak: lo nitzrecha ella limkom chatach.
Bishlama leman deamar zanav, hayeynu dichtiv: "vayyiven", ella leman deamar partzuf — may "vayyiven"?

Lechidrabbi shimon ben menasya. dedaresh rabbi shimon ben menasya: "vayyiven Adonai elohim et hatztzela" — melammed shekkilleah hakkadosh baruch hu lechavva veheviah leadam harishon, shekken bichrakke hayyam korin lekallaita bannayyta.
Davar acher: "vayyiven Adonai elohim", amar rav chisda, veamri la bematnita tana: melammed shebbenaah hakkadosh baruch hu lechavva kevinyayn
b: Otzar, ma otzar ze rachav millematta vekatzar milmala kede lekabbel et happerot — af haishsha rechava millematta uketzara milmala kede lekabbel et havvalad.
"Vayvieha el haadam" — melammed sheasa hakkadosh baruch hu shoshvinut laadam harishon, mikkan laggadol sheyyaase shoshvinut lakkatan veal yera lo.

Uleman deamar partzuf, he minnayyhu sage beresha? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: mistabbera dezachar sage beresha, detanya: lo yehallech adam achore ishsha badderech, vaafillu hi ishto. nizdammena al haggesher yesallekenna litzdadin. vechol haover achore ishsha bannahar — en lo chelek laolam habba.

Tanu rabbanan: hammartze maot leishsha miyyado leyadah o miyyadah leyado bishvil sheyyistakkel bah, afillu dome lemoshe rabbenu shekkibbel tora mehar sinay — lo yinnake middinah shel gehinnam. vealav hakkatuv omer: "yad leyad lo yinnake ra" — lo yinnake middinah shel gehinnam.
Amar rav nachman: manoach am haaretz haya, shenneemar: "vayyakom vayyelech manoach achare ishto".
Matkef la rav nachman bar yitzchak: ella meatta, gabbe elkana dichtiv: "vayyelech elkana achare ishto", hachi name? vegabbe elisha dichtiv: "vayyakom vayyelech achareha", hachi name?
Ella: achare devareha vaatzatah, hacha name — achare devareha vaatzatah.

Amar rav ashe: ulemay deamar rav nachman manoach am haaretz haya, afillu be rav name la kera. dichtiv: "vattakom rivka venaaroteha vattirkavna al haggemallim vattelachna achare haish", vela lifne haish.
Amar rabbi yochanan: achare ari velo achare ishsha. achare ishsha velo achare avoda zara. achore avoda zara velo achore bet hakkeneset beshaa shemmitpallelin.

Veamar rabbi yirmeya ben elazar: kol otan hashshanim shehaya adam harishon benidduy, holid ruchin veshedin velilin, shenneemar: "vaychi adam sheloshim umeat shana vayyoled bidmuto ketzalmo", mikkelal dead haiddana lav ketzalmo oled.

Metivi, haya rabbi meir omer: adam harishon chasid gadol haya, kevan sheraa shenniknesa mita al yado, yashav betaanit mea sheloshim shana, uferash min haishsha mea sheloshim shana, veheela zirze teenim al besaro mea sheloshim shana.
Ki kaamrinan hahu, beshichvat zera dachaza leuneseh.
Veamar rabbi yirmeya ben elazar: miktzat shivcho shel adam omrim befanav, vechullo shello befanav. miktzat shivcho befanav, dichtiv: "ki otcha raiti tzaddik lefanay baddor hazze",
Kullo shello befanav, dichtiv: "noach ish tzaddik tamim haya bedorotav".

Veamar rabbi yirmeya ben elazar, may dichtiv: "vehinne ale zayit taraf befiha" — amra yona lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, yihyu mezonotay merorin kezayit umesurin beyadcha, veal yihyu metukin kidvash uteluyin beyad basar vadam. ketiv hacha "taraf", uchetiv hatam "haterifeni lechem chukki".
Veamar rabbi yirmeya ben elazar: kol bayit shennishmain bo divre tora ballayla, shuv eno nechrav, shenneemar: "velo amar ayye eloah osay noten zemirot ballayla".
