Veamar rabbi yirmeya ben elazar: miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash, dayyo laolam sheyyishtammesh bishte otiyyot, shenneemar: "kol hanneshama tehallel yah haleluyah".

Veamar rabbi yirmeya ben elazar: nitkallela bavel — nitkallelu shecheneha, nitkallela shomron — nitbarchu shecheneha. nitkallela bavel nitkallelu shecheneha — dichtiv: "vesamtiha lemorash kippod veagme mayim". nitkallela shomron nitbarchu shecheneha — dichtiv: "vesamti shomron lei hassade

a: Lemattae charem".

Veamar rabbi yirmeya ben elazar: bo uree shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vedam. middat basar vadam, mitchayyev adam hariga lammalchut — metilin lo chakka letoch piv kede shello yekallel et hammelech.

Middat hakkadosh baruch hu, adam mitchayyev hariga lammakom — shotek, shenneemar: "lecha dumiyya tehilla", velo od ella shemmeshabbeach, shenneemar: "tehilla". velo od ella sheddome lo keillu makriv korban, shenneemar: "ulecha yeshullam neder".
Hayeynu deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: may dichtiv "ovre beemek habbacha mayan yeshituhu gam berachot yate more".

"Ovre" — ellu bene adam sheovrin al retzono shel hakkadosh baruch hu. "emek" — shemmaamikin lahem gehinnam. "habbacha" — shebbochin umoridin demaot kemayayn shel shitin. "gam berachot yate more" — shemmatzdikin alehem et haddin, veomrim lefanav: ribbono shel olam, yafe danta, yafe zikketa, yafe chiyyayvta, veyafe tikkanta gehinnam larshaim gan eden latztzaddikim.

Ini?! vehaamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: reshaim afillu al pitcho shel gehinnam enam chozrin bitshuva, shenneemar: "veyatzu verau befigre haanashim happoshim bi vegomer", "sheppashu" lo neemar, ella "happoshim" — shepposhim veholchin leolam!
La kashya: ha — befoshe yisrael, ha — befoshe ummot haolam.
Hachi name mistabbera, deim ken kashya deresh lakish adderesh lakish. deamar resh lakish: poshe yisrael en ur gehinnam sholetet bahen, kal vachomer mimmizbach hazzahav.

Ma mizbach hazzahav, sheen alav ella keovi dinar zahav, amad kamma shanim velo shalta bo haur. poshe yisrael, shemmelein mitzvot kerimmon, shenneemar: "kefelach harimmon rakkatech", veamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: al tikre "rakkatech" ella "rekatech", sheafillu rekanin shebbach melein mitzvot kerimmon — al achat kamma vechamma.

Ella ha dichtiv: "ovre beemek habbacha", hahu dimchayyeyvi hahi shata begehinnam, veate avraham avinu umassek lehu umekabbel lehu. bar miyyisrael shebba al haggoya, demashcha orlato vela mevashkar leh.
Matkef la rav kahana: hasheta deamrat "happoshim" — defashi veazli, ella meatta dichtiv "hammotzi" vehammaale" — demassek udemappek hu?! ella deassek veappek, hachi name — defashi hu.
Veamar rabbi yirmeya (bar) elazar: shelosha petachim yesh laggehinnam, echad bammidbar veechad bayyam veechad birushalayim. bammidbar, dichtiv: "vayyerdu hem vechol asher lahem chayyim sheola".
Bayyam, dichtiv: "mibbeten sheol shivvati shamata koli".

Birushalayim, dichtiv: "neum Adonai asher ur lo betziyyon vetannur lo birushalaym". vetana deve rabbi yishmael: "asher ur lo betziyyon" — zo gehinnam, "vetannur lo birushalayim" — zo pitchah shel gehinnam.

Vetu lekka? vehaamar rabbi mariyyon amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, veamri la tana rabba bar mariyyon bidve rabbi yochanan ben zakkay: shete temarot yesh bege ben hinnom veole ashan mibbenehen, vezo hi sheshshaninu: tzine har habbarzel kesherot, vezo hi pitchah shel gehinnam! — dilma hayeynu dirushalayim.
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: shiva shemot yesh legehinnam, veellu hen: sheol, vaavaddon, uveer shachat, uvor shaon, vetit hayyaven, vetzalmavet, veeretz hattachtit.

Sheol, dichtiv: "mibbeten sheol shivvati shamata koli". avaddon, dichtiv: "hayesuppar bakkever chasdecha emunatcha baavaddon". beer shachat, dichtiv: "ki lo taazov nafshi lishol lo titten chasidcha lirot shachat". uvor shaon vatit hayyaven, dichtiv: "vayyaaleni mibbor shaon mittit hayyaven". vetzalmavet, dichtiv: "yoshve choshech vetzalmavet". "veeretz hattachtit" — gemara hu.
Vetu lekka? vehaikka "gehinnam"! — ge sheamukka (begehinnam), shehakkol yored lah al iske hinnam.
Vehaikka "tofte", dichtiv: "ki aruch meetmul tofte", hahu shekkol hammitpatte beyitzro yippol sham.

Gan eden. amar resh lakish: im beeretz yisrael hu — bet shean pitcho, veim baaravya — bet gerem pitcho, veim ben hanneharot hu — dumaskenin pitcho. bevavel — abbaye mishtabbach befere demaavar yammina, rava mishtabbach befere deharpanya.
Uvenehen kimlo shete vechulei. peshita, kevan ditna leh dikshurot havu — anan yadinan dela havu muttarot!
Mahu detema: keshurot — keen keshurot, aval mammash la — ka mashma lan velo muttarot.
Achat nichneset veachat yotzet. tana: rivka nichneset verivka yotzet. tanu rabbanan: kamma roshah verubbah shel para — shete ammot, vechamma ovyah shel para — amma ushene shelishe amma.
b: Shehen keeser, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: kishlosh esre amma uchearba esre amma.
"Keeser"? ha eser havyayn! mishshum devae lemitna sefa "kishlosh esre".
"Kishlosh esre" — tefe havyayn? mishshum devae lemitne "kearba esre". "uchearba esre" — ha la havya? amar rav pappa: yeterot al shelosh esre, veenan maggiot learba esre.
Amar rav pappa: bevor shemone dechulle alma la peligi dela bainan peshutin.
Bevor shetem esre — dechulle alma la peligi devaenan peshutin.
Ki peligi — mishshemone ad shetem esre. lerabbi meir bainan peshutin. lerabbi yehuda la bainan peshutin.
Verav pappa may ka mashma lan? tenena?!
Rav pappa barayyta la shemia leh, veka mashma lan kevarayyta.
Arich yoter betel chitzat chatzer sheyyavsha siman. bea minneh abbaye merabba: heerich bidyomdin keshiur peshutin, lerabbi meir mahu?
Amar leh, tenetuha: "uvilvad sheyyarbe befassin". may lav demaarich bidyomdin? la, demappesh veaved peshutin.
I hachi, hay "uvilvad sheyyarbe befassin", "ad sheyyarbe passin" mibbee leh! teni "ad sheyyarbe passin".
Ikka deamri: amar leh, tenetuha: "uvilvad sheyyarbe befassin". may lav demappesh veaved peshutin? la, demaarich bidyomdin.
Hachi name mistabbera, middekatane "uvilvad sheyyarbe befassin". shema minna.
Bea minneh abbaye merabba: yoter mishshelosh esre amma ushelish lerabbi yehuda mahu? peshutin aved, o bidyomdin maarech?
Amar leh: tenetuha. kamma hen mekoravin — kede roshah verubbah shel para. vechamma meruchakin — afillu kor vaafillu korayim.
Rabbi yehuda omer: bet satayim muttar, yoter mibbet satayim asur. amru lo lerabbi yehuda: i atta mode bedir vesahar umuketze vechatzer, afillu bat chameshet korim vaafillu bat asara korim shemmuttar?
Amar lahen: zo mechitza, veellu passin.
Veim ita, zo mechitza vezo hi mechitza mibbee leh!
Hachi kaamar: zo torat mechitza aleha — ufirtzoteha beeser, veellu torat passin alehen — ufirtzotehen bishlosh esre amma ushelish.
Bea minneh abbaye merabba: tel hammitlakket asara mittoch arba, niddon mishshum deyomad o eno niddon mishshum deyomad?

Amar leh, tenetuha: rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: hayta sham even merubbaat roin, kol sheillu techallek veyesh bah amma lechan veamma lechan niddon mishshum deyomad, veim lav eno niddon mishshum deyomad.

Rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: hayta sham even agulla, roin kol sheillu techakek vetechalek veyesh bah amma lechan veamma lechan — niddon mishshum deyomad, veim lav — eno niddon mishshum deyomad.
Bemay ka mippalgi? mar savar: chad roin amrinan, tere roin la amrinan, umar savar: afillu tere roin name amrinan.
Bea minneh abbaye merabba: chitzat hakkanim kane kane pachot mishshelosha, niddon mishshum deyomad o lav?
Amar leh, tenetuha: haya sham ilan o gader o chitzat hakkanim niddon mishshum deyomad. may lav, kane kane pachot mishshelosha?
La, guderyata dikne. i hachi — hayeynu ilan.
Veella may: kane kane pachot mishshelosha — hayeynu gader! ella may it lach lememar, tere gavvne gader? hacha name — tere gavvne ilan.
Ikka deamri: guderyata dikne ka mibbaya leh. guderyata dikne may? amar leh, tenetuha: haya sham gader o ilan o chitzat hakkanim niddon mishshum deyomad. may lav, guderyata dikne?
La, kana kane pachot mishshelosha. i hachi, hayeynu gader!
Veella may: guderyata dikne — hayeynu ilan! ella may it lach lememar,

a: Tere gavvne ilan? hacha name, tere gavvne gader.
Bea minneh abbaye merabba: chatzer sheroshah nichnas leven happassin — mahu letaltel mittochah leven happassin, umibben happassin letochah? amar leh: muttar.
Shetayim, may? amar leh: asur.
Amar rav huna: shetayim asurin, vaafillu ervu. gezera shemma yomru "eruv moil leven happassin". rava amar: ervu muttar.

Amar leh abbaye lerava: tanya dimsayyay lach — chatzer sheroshah echad nichnas leven happassin muttar letaltel mittochah leven happassin umibben happassin letochah, aval shetayim asur. bamme devarim amurim shello ervu, aval ervu muttarin.
Lema tehve teyuveta derav huna?! amar lecha rav huna: hatam dehadran vearvan.
Bea minneh abbaye merabba: yavshu mayim beshabbat mahu? amar leh: kelum naaset mechitza ella bishvil mayim, mayim en kan mechitza en kan.
Bae ravin: yavshu mayim beshabbat uvau beshabbat mahu? amar leh abbaye: yavshu beshabbat la tibbee lach, divay minneh demar ufeshet li daasir.
Bau name la tibbee lach — dehave leh mechitza haasuya beshabbat, vetanya: kol mechitza haasuya beshabbat, ben beshogeg ben bemezid ben beones ben birtzon — shemah mechitza.
Velav ittemar ala, amar rav nachman: lo shanu ella lizrok, aval letaltel — lo.
Ki ittemar derav nachman — ammezid ittemar.
Amar rabbi elazar: hazzorek leven passe habberaot chayyayv. peshita, i lav mechitza hi — hechi mishtere leh lemalloot?!
La tzericha, daavad keen passe veraot birshut harabbim, vezarak letochah — chayyayv.
Ha name peshita! i lav divalma mechitza hi — gabbe vor hechi mishtere leh letaltole? la tzericha, af al gav deka baki bah rabbim.
Umay ka mashma lan — dela atu rabbim umevatteli mechitzta, ha amar rabbi elazar chada zimna!

Ditnan, rabbi yehuda omer: im hayta derech reshut harabbim mafsaktan — yesallekenna litzdadin, vachachamim omrim: eno tzarich. rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar deamri tarvavyyhu: kan hodiacha kochan shel mechitztzot.
I mehatam, hava amena 'kan — vela sevira leh. ka mashma lan 'kan — usevira leh.
Velema ha, vela bae hach! chada mikkelal chavertah ittemar.

Muttar lehakeriv labbeer vechulei. tenan hatam: lo yaamod adam birshut harabbim veyishte birshut hayyachid, birshut hayyachid veyishte birshut harabbim, ella im ken machnis rosho verubbo limkom shehu shote.
b: Vechen baggat.
Gabbe adam — ha amar devae rosho verubbo. gabbe para — mi bainan la roshah verubbah o la?
Kol hecha deka naket mana vela naket la — la tibbee lach devae roshah verubbah millegav. ki tibbee lach — hecha denaket mana venaket la, may?
Amar leh, tenetuha: uvilvad shettehe happara roshah verubbah mibbifnim veshota. may lav, denaket la venaket mana? la, denaket mana vela naket la.
Vechi naket mana vela naket la, mi shere? vehatanya: lo yemalle adam mayim veyitten beshabbat lifne vehemto, aval memalle hu veshofech, vehi shota meeleha!
Ha ittemar ala: amar abbaye, hacha beevus haomed birshut harabbim gavoah asara tefachim verochav arbaa, verosho echad nichnas leven happassin.
Gezera dilma chaze leh leevus dimkalkal veate letakkoneh, vedare leh ledavvla bahadeh, veka mappek mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim.

Vechi hay gavvna mi michayyayv? vehaamar rav safra amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan: hamefanne chafatzav mizzavit lezavit, venimlach alehen vehotzian — patur, shello hayta akira mishshaa rishona lechach.
Ella: zimnin dimtakken leh vahadar meayyel leh, veka meayyel mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid.
Ikka deamri: gabbe adam ha kaamrinan desaggi leh berosho verubbo. gabbe fara mi saggi la beroshah verubbah, o la?
Hecha denaket mana venaket la — la tibbee lach desaggi la beroshah verubbah, ella ki tibbee lach denaket mana vela naket la, may?
Amar leh, tenetuha: uvilvad shettehe para roshah verubbah mibbifnim veshota. may lav denaket mana vela naket la: la, denaket mana venaket la.
Vehachi name mistabbera, dei naket mana vela naket la, mi shere? vehatanya: lo yemalle adam mayim veyitten lifne behemto, aval memalle veshofech vehi shota meeleha!

Ha ittemar ala amar abbaye: hacha beevus haomed birshut harabbim gavoah asara tefachim verochav arbaa, verosho nichnas leven happassin, dezimnin dechaze leh leevus dimkalkal veate letakkoneh, vedare leh ledavvla bahadeh, veka mappek mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim.

Vechi hay gavvna mi michayyayv? vehaamar rav safra amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan: hamefanne chafatzav mizzavit lezavit venimlach alehen vehotzian — patur, shello hayta akira mishshaa rishona lechach!
Ella: zimnin dimtakken leh vahadar meayyel leh, veka meayyel leh mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid.
Ta shema: gamal sherosho verubbo mibbifnim ovsin oto mibbifnim, veha ibbus keman denaket mana venaket la damya, veka bainan roshah verubbah!
Amar rav acha bar rav huna amar rav sheshet: shane gamal, hoil vetzavvaro aroch.
Ta shema: behema sheroshah verubbah bifnim ovsin otah mibbifnim. veha evus keman denaket mana venaket la, veka bainan rosho verubbo! may 'behema name dekatane — gamal.
Vehatanya 'behema vehatanya 'gamal!
Midde gabbe hadade tanya?! tanya name hachi: rabbi elazar oser begamal, hoil vetzavvaro aroch.
Amar rabbi yitzchak bar adda: lo hutteru passe veraot ella leole regalim bilvad. vehatanya: lo hutteru passe veraot ella legabbe vehema bilvad! may behema — behemat ole regalim. aval adam

a: Metappes veole metappes veyored.
Ini? vehaamar rav yitzchak amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo hutteru passe veraot ella liver mayim chayyim bilvad. vei livhema, ma li chayyim ma li mechunnasin? bainan midde dachaze leadam.

Gufa: lo hutteru passe veraot ella livhema bilvad, aval adam metappes veole metappes veyored. veim hayu rechavin, afillu leadam name. velo yemalle adam mayim veyitten lifne vehemto, aval memalle hu veshofech lifne behema veshota meeleha.
Matkef la rav anan: im ken, ma hoilu passe veraot? ma hoilu?! lemalloot mehen!
Ella: ma hoil roshah verubbah shel para?
Amar abbaye: hacha bemay askinan — beevus haomed birshut harabbim gavoah asara verochav arbaa verosho nichnas leven happassin vechulei.
Amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav: en bureganin bevavel, velo passe veraot bechutz laaretz.
Bureganin bevavel la — dishchichi bidke, passe veraot bechutz laaretz la — dela shechichi metivata. aval ippecha avdinan.
Ikka deamri, amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav: en bureganin ufasse veraot, lo bevavel velo bachutz laaretz. bureganin bevavel lo — dishchichi bidke, bechutz laaretz name la — dishchichi gannave.
Passe veraot bevavel la — dishchichi mayya. bechutz laaretz name la — dela shechichi metivata.

Amar leh rav chisda lemari bereh derav huna bereh derav yirmeya bar abba: amri atetu mibbarnish leve chenishta dedaniyyel dahava telata parse beshabbeta, ammay samchitu — abbureganin? ha amar avu daavu mishshemeh derav: en bureganin bevavel!
Nafek veachvi leh hanhu matavota, demibbalan beshivim amma veshirayim.

Amar rav chisda, daresh mari bar mar: may dichtiv "lechol tichla raiti ketz rechava mitzvatcha meod", davar ze amaro david velo persho, amaro iyyov velo persho, amaro yechezkel velo persho, ad shebba zecharya ben iddo ufersho.
Amaro david velo persho, dichtiv: "lechol tichla raiti ketz rechava mitzvatcha meod". amaro iyyov velo persho, dichtiv: "arukka meeretz middah urechava minni yam".
Amaro yechezkel velo persho, dichtiv: "vayyifros otah lefanay vehi chetuva panim veachor vechatuv eleha kinim vahege vahi".

"Kinim" — zo pureanutan shel tzaddikim baolam hazze, vechen hu omer: "kina hi vekonnuha". "vahege" — zo mattan secharan shel tzaddikim leatid lavo, vechen hu omer: "ale higgayon bechinnor". "vahi" — zo hi pureanutan shel reshaim leatid lavo, vechen hu omer: "hova al hova tavo".

Ad shebba zecharya ben iddo ufersho, dichtiv: "vayyomer elay ma atta roe vaomar ani roe megilla afa orkah esrim baamma verochbah eser baamma". vechi pashtat la, havya la esrin beesrin. uchetiv: "hi chetuva panim veachor", vechi kalfat la, kamma havya la — arbein beesrin.
Uchetiv: "mi madad beshoolo mayim veshamayim bazzeret tikken vegomer" — nimtza kol haolam kullo echad mishsheloshet alafim umatayim battora.
Veamar rav chisda, daresh mari bar mar, may dichtiv: "vehinne shene dudae teenim muadim lifne hechal Adonai. haddud haechad teenim tovot meod kitene
b: Habbakkurot vehaddud haechad teenim raot meod asher lo teachalna meroa" —

Teenim hattovot — ellu tzaddikim gemurim. teenim haraot — ellu reshaim gemurim. veshemma tomar avad sivram uvatal sikkuyam? talmud lomar: "haddudaim natnu reach" — ellu vaellu atidin sheyyittenu reach.
Daresh rava, may dichtiv: "haddudaim natnu reach" — ellu bachure yisrael shello taamu taam chet.
"Veal petachenu kol megadim" — ellu benot yisrael shemmaggidot pitchehen levaalehen. lashon acher: sheogdot pitchehen levaalehen.
"Chadashim gam yeshanim dodi tzafanti lach" — amra keneset yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, harebe gezerot gazarti al atzmi yoter mimma sheggazarta alay, vekiyyaymtim.
Amar leh rav chisda lehahu midderabbanan dahava ka mesaddar aggadata kammeh: mi shemia lach "chadashim gam yeshanim" mahu? amar leh: ellu mitzvot kallot veellu mitzvot chamurot.
Amar leh: vechi tora peamim peamim nittena? ella — hallalu middivre tora, vehallalu middivre sofrim.

Daresh rava, may dichtiv: "veyoter mehemma beni hizzaher asot sefarim harebe vegomer" — beni, hizzaher bedivre sofrim yoter middivre tora. sheddivre tora yesh bahen ase velo taase. vedivre sofrim — kol haover al divre sofrim chayyayv mita.
Shemma tomar: im yesh bahen mammash, mippene ma lo nichtevu?! amar kera: "asot sefarim harebe en ketz".
"Velahag harebe yegiat basar" — amar rav pappa bereh derav acha bar adda mishshemeh derav acha bar ulla: melammed shekkol hammalig al divre chachamim, niddon betzoa rotachat.
Matkef la rava: mi ketiv laag? "lahag" ketiv! ella: kol hahoge bahen toem taam basar.

Tanu rabbanan: maase berabbi akiva shehaya chavush bevet haasurin, vehaya rabbi yehoshua haggarsi mesharto. bechol yom vayom hayu machnisin lo mayim bemidda. yom echad metzao shomer bet haasurin, amar lo: hayyom memecha merubbin, shemma lachtor bet haasurin atta tzarich? shafach chetzyayn venatan lo chetzyayn.
Keshebba etzel rabbi akiva, amar lo: yehoshua, en atta yodea shezzaken ani vechayyay teluyin bechayyecha?

Sach lo kol oto hameora. amar lo: ten li mayim sheettol yaday, amar lo: lishtot en maggiin, littol yadecha maggiin?! amar lo: ma eese shechayyayvim alehen mita? mutav amut mitat atzmi, velo eevor al daat chaveray!

Amru: lo taam kelum ad shehevi lo mayim venatal yadav, kesheshshamu chachamim baddavar, amru: ma beziknuto kach, beyalduto al achat kamma vechamma. uma bevet haasurin kach, shello bevet haasurin al achat kamma vechamma.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: beshaa shettikken shelomo eruvin unetilat yadayim, yatzta bat kol veamra: "beni im chacham libbecha yismach libbi gam ani". veomer: "chacham beni vesammach libbi veashiva chorfi davar".
Daresh rava: may dichtiv "lecha dodi netze hassade nalina bakkefarim nashkima lakkeramim nire im parcha haggefen pittach hassemadar henetzu harimmonim sham etten et doday lach".

"Lecha dodi netze hassade" — amra keneset yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, al tedineni keyoshve cherakkim sheyyesh bahen gazel vaarayot ushevuat shav ushevuat sheker, "netze hassade" — bo vearacha talmide chachamim, sheoskin battora mittoch haddechak.
"Nalina bakkefarim" — al tikre bakkefarim ella bakkofrim: bo vearacha otam shehishpata lahen tova vehen kafru becha.

"Nashkima lakkeramim" — ellu batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot. "nire im parcha haggefen" — ellu baale mikra. "pittach hassemadar" — ellu baale mishna. "henetzu harimmonim" — ellu baale gemara. "sham etten et doday lach" — aracha kevodi vegodli shevach banay uvenotay.

Amar rav hamenuna, may dichtiv: "vaydabber sheloshet alafim mashal vayhi shiro chamishsha vaalef" — melammed sheamar shelomo al kol davar vedavar shel tora sheloshet alafim mashal, al kol davar vedavar shel sofrim chamishsha veelef teamim.

Daresh rava, may dichtiv: "veyoter shehaya kohelet chacham od limmad daat et haam [v]izzen vechikker tikken meshalim harebe". "limmad daat et haam" — deagmeray besimane teamim, veasbera bemay dedame lay.
"[V]izzen vechikker tikken meshalim harebe" — amar ulla amar rabbi eliezer: battechilla hayta tora doma lichfifa sheen lah oznayim, ad shebba shelomo veasa lah oznayim.
"Kevutztzotav taltallim", amar rav chisda amar mar ukeva: melammed sheyyesh lidrosh al kol kotz vakotz tille tillim shel halachot.
"Shechorot kaorev": bemi atta motzan — bemi

a: Shemmashkim umaariv alehen levet hammidrash. rabba amar: bemi shemmashchir panav alehen keorev.

Rava amar: bemi shemmesim atzmo achzari al banav veal bene beto keorev. ki ha derav adda bar matna hava kaazel leve rav, amara leh devethu: yanoke didach may eeved lehu? amar la: mi shelimu kurame beagma?
"Umeshallem lesonav el panav lehaavido", amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: ilmale mikra katuv, i efshar leomro — kivyachol keadam shennose massoy al panav, umevakkesh lehashelicho mimmennu.
"Lo yeacher lesono", amar rabbi ila: lesonav hu delo yeacher, aval yeacher latztzaddikim gemurim.
Vehayeynu deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: may dichtiv "asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom laasotam", "hayyom laasotam" — velo lemachar laasotam, "hayyom laasotam" — lemachar lekabbel secharam.
Amar rabbi chaggay, veittema rabbi shemuel bar nachmani: may dichtiv "erech appayim"? "erech af" mibbee leh!
Ella erech appayim letzaddikim, erech appayim larshaim.
Rabbi yehuda omer ad bet satayim vechulei. ibbaya lehu: bor ufassin kaamar, o dilma bor velo passin kaamar?
Adam noten enav bevoro, vela gazrinan dilma ate letaltole yoter mibbet satayim bekarpef;
O dilma, adam noten enav bimchitzato, vegazrinan dilma ate leichallofe yoter mibbet satayim bekarpef.
Ta shema: kamma hen mekoravin — kede roshah verubbah shel para, vechamma hen meruchakin — afillu kor afillu korayim. rabbi yehuda omer: bet satayim — muttar, yater mibbet satayim — asur.
Amru lerabbi yehuda: i atta mode bedir vesahar muketze vechatzer, afillu bet chameshet korim uvet aseret korim, shemmuttar.
Amar lahem: zo mechitza, veellu passin.
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: bor bet satayim abbet satayim — muttar, velo amru leharechik ella kede roshah verubbah shel para.
Ha middekaamar rabbi shimon ben elazar bor velo passin, mikkelal derabbi yehuda bor ufassin kaamar. vela hi, rabbi yehuda bor belo passin kaamar.
I hachi, hayeynu derabbi shimon ben elazar! ikka benayyhu arich vekattin.
Kelal amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: kol avir shettashmisho ledira, kegon dir vesahar muketze vechatzer, afillu bet chameshet korim uvet aseret korim — muttar.
Vechol dira shettashmishah laavir, kegon bureganin shebbassadot, bet satayim — muttar, yeter mibbet satayim — asur.
Mishna rabbi yehuda omer: im haya derech reshut harabbim mafsaktan — yesallekenna litzdadin. vachachamim omrim: eno tzarich.
Gemara rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar deamri tarvavyyhu: kan hodiacha kochan shel mechitztzot.
Kan, usevira leh? vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: yerushalayim, ilmale daltoteha ninalot ballayla, chayyayvin aleha mishshum reshut harabbim.
Ella: kan — vela sevira leh.
Uremi derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda. uremi derabbanan adderabbanan.

Detanya, yater al ken amar rabbi yehuda: mi shehayu lo shene vattim mishshene tzidde reshut harabbim, ose lo lechi mikkan velechi mikkan, o kora mikkan vekora mikkan, venose venoten baemtza. amru lo: en mearvin reshut harabbim bechach.
Kashya derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda, kashya derabbanan adderabbanan.
Derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda la kashya: hatam — deikka shete mechitztzot mealleyayta. hacha — lekka shete mechitztzot mealleyayta,
Derabbanan adderabbanan [name] la kashya: hacha — ikka shem arba mechitztzot, hatam — lekka shem arba mechitztzot.
Amar rabbi yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan: eretz yisrael en chayyayvin aleha mishshum reshut harabbim. yatev rav dimi vekaamar leh leha shemata. amar leh abbaye lerav dimi: may tama?
b: Illema mishshum demakkef la sullema detzor mehach gisa umachtana degader mehach gisa — bavel name, makkif le perat mehach gisa vediglat mehay gisa! dechulla alma name makkif okyaynos! dilma maalot umoradot kaamrat?
Amar leh: karkafna, chaziteh lereshach be ammude ki amar rabbi yochanan leha shemata.

Ittemar name, ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan, veamri la, amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: maalot umoradot shebbeeretz yisrael en chayyayvin alehen mishshum reshut harabbim lefi sheenan kedigle midbar.
Bea minneh rachava merava: tel hammitlakket asara mittoch arba, verabbim bokin bo, chayyayvin alav mishshum reshut harabbim o en chayyayvin alav?
Allibba derabbanan la tibbee lach: hasheta, uma hatam denicha tashmishteh — amri rabbanan la atu rabbim umevatteli la mechitzta, hacha, dela nicha tashmishteh — lo kol shekken!
Ki tibbee lach allibba derabbi yehuda. may, hatam hu denicha tashmishteh, hacha hu dela nicha tashmishteh — la atu rabbim umevatteli mechitzta? o dilma la shena? amar leh: chayyayvin.
Vaafillu olin lo bechevel? amar leh: in. vaafillu bemaalot bet maron?! amar leh: in.
Etiveh: chatzer sheharabbim nichnasin lah bazo veyotzin bazo — reshut harabbim lattumea, ureshut hayyachid lashshabbat.
Manni? illema rabbanan, hasheta uma hatam — denicha tashmishteh, amri rabbanan: la atu rabbim umevatteli mechitzta, hacha — dela nicha tashmishteh, lo kol shekken!
Ella lav, rabbi yehuda hi?
La, leolam rabbanan, ureshut harabbim lattumea itztericha leh.
Ta shema: mevoot hamefullashot bevorot, beshichin uvimarot — reshut hayyachid leshabbat ureshut harabbim lattumea.
"Bevorot" salka datach? ella: levorot — reshut hayyachid leshabbat ureshut harabbim lattumea.
Manni? illema rabbanan, hasheta uma hatam — denicha tashmishteh, amri: la atu rabbim umevatteli la, hacha — dela nicha tashmishteh, lo kol shekken! ella lav rabbi yehuda hi?
La, leolam rabbanan, ureshut harabbim lattumea itztericha leh.
Ta shema: shevile bet gilgul vechayyotze bahen — reshut hayyachid lashshabbat ureshut harabbim lattumea.
Veezehu shevile bet gilgul? amri deve rabbi yannay: kol sheen haeved yachol littol sea shel chittin veyarutz lifne sardeyot.
Manni? illema rabbanan, hasheta uma hatam — denicha tashmishta, amri rabbanan: la atu rabbim umevatteli la mechitzta. hacha — dela nicha tashmishta, lo kol shekken! ella lav, rabbi yehuda hi?

Amar leh: shevile bet gilgul kaamrat? yehoshua ohev yisrael haya, amad vetikken lahem derachim useratya, kol hecha denicha tashmishta — mesarah larabbim, kol hecha dela nicha tashmishta — mesarah layyachid.
Mishna echad bor harabbim uveer harabbim uveer hayyachid — osin lahen passin.
Aval levor hayyachid — osin lo mechitza gavoah asara tefachim, divre rabbi akiva.
Rabbi yehuda ben bava omer: en osin passin ella liver harabbim bilvad, velashshear — osin chagora gavoah asara tefachim.
